jobs.title: Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR124693 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Digital Manufacturing Technology Team Lead “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures transition into Industry 4.0 tools and practices” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with Industry 4.0 to accelerate digitalization and support more connected operational use cases bringing more efficiency and quality, based on latest technologies for Industrial IoT, Automation, No/Low Coding platforms and Analytics. The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Digital Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Digital Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Production, and Maintenance. This scope requires specialized solutions as back-End like SAP PP, Rhize MES, and Asset Maintenance Solutions, which are exposed to various Manufacturing Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. In a logic of real-time execution and data driven, Richemont is applying advanced solution regarding the IIOT (Industrial Internet of Things) for machine connectivity, with the ambition of an harmonized data conversion (based on ISA95 concept) to make data accessible from our entire manufacture to a single point (Unified NameSpace). Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer with strong emphasis in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Production as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & MES from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP PP, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first Technical interview with the Manufacturing Product Area Manager and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with him/her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Manufacturing Processes Definition & Integration Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Upstream Supply Chain Planning Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR124693 Richemont possiede alcune delle più importanti Maison di lusso al mondo, con punti di forza particolari in gioielleria, orologi di alta gamma e accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont si impegna a preservare il patrimonio e l’identità di ciascuna di esse. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maisons, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. Responsabile del Team Tecnologico della Produzione Digitale “Unisciti a un ambiente dinamico di Tecnologia e Business per aiutare le nostre Industrie a transitare verso strumenti e pratiche Industry 4.0” CONTESTO Le nostre Industrie hanno intrapreso un percorso con Industry 4.0 per accelerare la digitalizzazione e supportare casi d’uso operativi più connessi, portando maggiore efficienza e qualità, basandosi sulle tecnologie più recenti per Industrial IoT, Automazione, piattaforme No/Low Coding e Analytics. L’ambito delle nostre operazioni di produzione copre oltre 30 siti in Europa, di cui più di 20 in Svizzera, con attività principalmente legate a orologeria e gioielleria, dal metodo tradizionale a pratiche più industrializzate. COME POTRAI FARE LA DIFFERENZA? Il ruolo è inserito nel “Operations & Services” del Gruppo Richemont e fa parte dell’Area di Prodotto Manufacturing. Come Responsabile del Team Tecnologico della Produzione Digitale, tu e il tuo team sarete responsabili dell’analisi, progettazione, implementazione e supporto dei diversi componenti dell’Architettura delle Applicazioni di Produzione Digitale. Sarai responsabile dei miglioramenti e della consegna delle applicazioni secondo la roadmap del nostro “Product Owner” e le linee guida dei nostri Architetti. Il nostro ambito di Produzione Digitale include tutti i processi aziendali della catena del valore relativi a Produzione e Manutenzione. Questo richiede soluzioni specializzate come SAP PP, Rhize MES e soluzioni di Asset Maintenance, esposte a vari Front-End di Esecuzione della Produzione. Questa strategia di decoupling è supportata in un panorama moderno basato su API e Architettura Event-Driven. In una logica di esecuzione in tempo reale e orientata ai dati, Richemont applica soluzioni avanzate riguardanti l’IIOT (Internet Industriale delle Cose) per la connettività delle macchine, con l’ambizione di una conversione dati armonizzata (basata sul concetto ISA95) per rendere i dati accessibili dall’intera produzione in un punto unico (Unified NameSpace). Responsabilità Chiave: - Definire una Visione Tecnica e mantenere la roadmap in linea con la strategia di prodotto e l’architettura aziendale. - Gestire un Team Tecnologico di consulenti esperti nella progettazione, implementazione e supporto delle nostre soluzioni per le Industrie, secondo le pratiche Agile. - Guidare, sviluppare e motivare il team per proporre le migliori soluzioni e apprendere continuamente nuove competenze e tecnologie. - Garantire la conformità alle linee guida di architettura e sicurezza. - Preparare il Budget e pianificare la capacità del team per supportare tutte le iniziative richieste dalle Maisons. - Collaborare e essere il punto di contatto principale per integrare con altri team su tutte le tematiche di integrazione. COME MISURERAI IL TUO SUCCESSO CON NOI? - Laurea magistrale / Ingegnere con forte specializzazione in Ingegneria Industriale o Meccanica - Oltre 7 anni di esperienza, idealmente con background di consulenza, in ambienti industriali di Produzione e IT - Solida esperienza in ciclo completo di progetti di implementazione di ERP e MES di produzione, dalla progettazione all’esecuzione - Mentalità di leadership collaborativa e coaching. - Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni aziendali basate su SAP PP, con esperienze MES, preferibilmente anche con piattaforme Low Code / No Code. - Buona comprensione dei principi di progettazione dell’architettura e delle tecnologie di integrazione come API. - Buona conoscenza del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo software e personalizzazione in modelli Agile e Scrum. - Esperienza nella gestione di team, supervisionando attività di progettazione, implementazione e supporto, inclusa la pianificazione e il budget. - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione tecnica con la direzione, colleghi e partner industriali. COME TI FACCIAMO SORRIDERE? - Il ruolo è un mix perfetto tra progettare, costruire e mantenere nuove soluzioni, sviluppando e guidando un team agile esperto al servizio di tutte le Industrie delle nostre Maisons. - La varietà e la densità delle iniziative con le nostre Maisons offrono un portafoglio di opportunità per apprendere e sviluppare nuove competenze. - In Richemont possiamo e discutiamo con tutti i livelli di tecnologia e business, e il tuo valore aggiunto e i tuoi consigli sono molto apprezzati dagli stakeholder. IL TUO VIAGGIO CON NOI: 1. Se la tua candidatura sarà selezionata, ti contatteremo al più presto per una chiamata introduttiva informale. 2. Il passo successivo sarà un primo colloquio tecnico con il Responsabile dell’Area di Prodotto Manufacturing e, se ci sarà compatibilità, avrai un incontro personale con lui/lei e il nostro HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Posizioni correlate: - Responsabile Team Tecnologico Definizione e Integrazione Processi di Produzione - Richemont Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead - Richemont Upstream Supply Chain Planning Tech Team Lead

Reference code: JR124693 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Digital Manufacturing Technology Team Lead “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures transition into Industry 4.0 tools and practices” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with Industry 4.0 to accelerate digitalization and support more connected operational use cases bringing more efficiency and quality, based on latest technologies for Industrial IoT, Automation, No/Low Coding platforms and Analytics. The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Digital Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Digital Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Production, and Maintenance. This scope requires specialized solutions as back-End like SAP PP, Rhize MES, and Asset Maintenance Solutions, which are exposed to various Manufacturing Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. In a logic of real-time execution and data driven, Richemont is applying advanced solution regarding the IIOT (Industrial Internet of Things) for machine connectivity, with the ambition of an harmonized data conversion (based on ISA95 concept) to make data accessible from our entire manufacture to a single point (Unified NameSpace). Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer with strong emphasis in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Production as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & MES from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP PP, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR124693 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüterhäuser, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, hochwertigen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. DEIN WEG MIT UNS: 1. Wenn deine Bewerbung ausgewählt wird, werden wir uns so schnell wie möglich mit dir in Verbindung setzen, um einen informellen Einführungsgespräch zu führen. 2. Codice di riferimento: JR124656 La storia di Cartier si basa su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbracciamo uno spirito audace e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team in tutti i Métiers, dalle boutique ai laboratori e agli uffici aziendali. I nostri oltre 10.000 colleghi di più di 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della nostra Maison spingendo i limiti della creatività e dell’innovazione. QUAL È IL TUO IMPATTO MISSIONE Nel nostro dipartimento di Sviluppo, cerchiamo un/una Progettista-Gioielliere per definire e progettare i prodotti finiti, tenendo conto delle restrizioni tecnologiche, estetiche, di budget e di qualità. RESPONSABILITÀ Sei incaricato di redigere un capitolato tecnico integrando i criteri di ergonomia, integrità e riparabilità di un gioiello espressi dalla Creazione, dall’esperto gioielliere e dal servizio clienti. Trascrivi le esigenze della Creazione (gouache) in un volume CAD 3D secondo gli standard della Maison Cartier. Sei garante della fattibilità durante la progettazione del prodotto in collaborazione con i tecnici di metodi.
• Presenti i prototipi in resina per la validazione del concetto da parte della Creazione.
• Garantisci la conformità del prototipo fisico (oro/platino) prima della validazione da parte della Creazione.
• Presenti il prototipo fisico alla Creazione e argomenta le scelte tecniche se necessario. Realizzi il dossier tecnico completo comprendente i volumi 3D (seguendo la metodologia di disegno della Maison Cartier), le tavole di progetto e le catene di quote che garantiscono il rispetto del capitolato, nonché le distinte base dei prodotti (dossier di catena di quote con 2D/3D) in collaborazione con i reparti di metodi e qualità. Fornisci i dati necessari alla creazione delle referenze prodotto nel PLM. Partecipa alla affidabilità e al miglioramento continuo dei prodotti. COSA CERCHIAMO Diploma di laurea in ingegneria in microtecnica, meccanica, progettazione ergonomica e design o equivalente, con almeno 3 anni di esperienza confermata in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente in un ambiente industriale. Sei a tuo agio con la CAO, idealmente su CREO, e hai una buona padronanza dell’analisi funzionale e delle catene di quote. Possiedi solide conoscenze in assemblaggi tecnici, integrando le restrizioni di fattibilità industriale tramite lavorazioni meccaniche. Grazie al tuo senso delle priorità, sei in grado di gestire progetti di grande portata e di lavorare in completa autonomia. Le tue competenze comunicative ti permettono di presentare e difendere i tuoi progetti con facilità durante le riunioni. Grazie alla tua flessibilità, rigore e capacità di instaurare relazioni, intrattieni scambi proficui con le diverse interfacce. LA TUA ESPERIENZA CON NOI Il nostro team HR è a tua disposizione, secondo le tue preferenze e necessità, durante tutto il percorso di selezione. Man mano che avanzi nel processo di reclutamento, incontrerai il nostro HR Business Partner e il/la Responsabile della posizione, e parteciperai a studi di caso o valutazioni in base alle esigenze del ruolo. Scrivi il prossimo capitolo della tua storia con Cartier. Reference code: JR124656 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. WHAT WILL BE YOUR IMPACT
• MISSION
• Within our Development department, we are looking for a Jewelry Designer to define and design finished products, taking into account technological, aesthetic, budgetary, and quality constraints. RESPONSIBILITIES You are responsible for creating a specifications document that incorporates ergonomic, integrity, and reparability criteria of a jewelry piece expressed by the Creation, the jewelry expert, and the customer service.
• You transcribe the Creation’s needs (gouache) into a 3D CAD volume following the Maison Cartier standards.
• You ensure the feasibility during product design in collaboration with methods technicians.
• You present resin prototypes for concept validation by the Creation.
• You guarantee the conformity of the physical prototype (gold/platinum) before validation by the Creation.
• You present the physical prototype to the Creation and argue technical choices if necessary. You produce the complete technical dossier including 3D volumes (following Cartier’s drawing methodology), drawings, dimension chains ensuring the requirements in the specifications, and product bills of materials (2D/3D dimension chain dossier) in collaboration with methods and quality. You provide data necessary for creating product references in the PLM. You participate in the reliability and continuous improvement of products. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Holder of an engineering degree in microtechnology, mechanics, ergonomic design, or equivalent, with confirmed experience of at least 3 years in a similar role, ideally within an industrial environment.
• You are comfortable with CAD, ideally CREO, and have a good understanding of functional analysis and dimension chains.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Referenzcode: JR124656 Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit über 170 Jahren pflegen wir einen mutigen, pionierhaften Geist, der unsere Teams in allen Métiers inspiriert – von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Firmenbüros. Über 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationen sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und das Streben nach Exzellenz vereint, wobei wir kontinuierlich das Erbe unseres Hauses bereichern, indem wir die Grenzen von Kreativität und Innovation verschieben. WAS WIRD IHR BEITRAG SEIN MISSION Innerhalb unserer Entwicklungsabteilung suchen wir einen/eine Schmuckdesigner/in, um die Endprodukte zu definieren und zu entwerfen, wobei technologische, ästhetische, budgetäre und Qualitätsanforderungen berücksichtigt werden. VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung eines Lastenhefts, das ergonomische, Integritäts- und Reparaturkriterien eines Schmuckstücks umfasst, die von der Kreation, dem Juwelierexperten und dem Kundenservice formuliert wurden. Sie übertragen die Bedürfnisse der Kreation (Gouache) in ein 3D-CAD-Volumen nach den Standards der Maison Cartier. Sie sind Garant für die Machbarkeit während der Produktentwicklung in Zusammenarbeit mit den Methoden-Technikern. Sie präsentieren Resin-Prototypen zur Konzeptvalidierung durch die Kreation. Sie gewährleisten die Konformität des physischen Prototyps (Gold/Platin) vor der Validierung durch die Kreation. Sie präsentieren den physischen Prototyp der Kreation und argumentieren technische Entscheidungen bei Bedarf. Sie erstellen das vollständige technische Dossier, einschließlich 3D-Volumen (nach der Zeichnungsmethodik der Maison Cartier), Zeichnungen, Maßketten, die die
• Anforderungen des Lastenhefts erfüllen, sowie Stücklisten der Produkte (Dossier mit 2D/3D-Maßkette) in Zusammenarbeit mit den Methoden- und Qualitätsabteilungen. Sie liefern die Daten, die für die Erstellung von Produktreferenzen im PLM notwendig sind. Sie tragen zur Zuverlässigkeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Produkte bei. WAS WIR SUCHEN Träger eines Ingenieurabschlusses in Mikrotechnik, Mechanik, ergonomischem Design oder Ähnlichem, mit mindestens 3 Jahren nachweislicher Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position, idealerweise in einem industriellen Umfeld. Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit CAD, idealerweise CREO, und verfügen über ein gutes Verständnis für funktionale Analyse und Maßketten. Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in technischen Montagen, die die Machbarkeitsbeschränkungen durch Bearbeitung integrieren. Dank Ihrer Priorisierungsfähigkeiten können Sie große Projekte eigenständig managen. Ihre Kommunikationsfähigkeiten ermöglichen es Ihnen, Ihre Projekte sicher zu präsentieren und zu verteidigen. Dank Ihrer Flexibilität, Strenge und Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen, pflegen Sie erfolgreiche Austausch mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen. IHRE ERFAHRUNG BEI UNS Unser HR-Team steht Ihnen jederzeit zur Verfügung, um Ihre Bedürfnisse und Wünsche während Ihrer gesamten Erfahrung bei unserem Haus zu hören. Im Verlauf unseres Rekrutierungsprozesses treffen Sie unseren HR Business Partner und den/ die Verantwortliche/n der Position und nehmen an Fallstudien oder Bewertungen teil, je nach Bedarf. Schreiben Sie das nächste Kapitel Ihrer Geschichte mit Cartier. Reference code: JR124656 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT MISSION Au sein de notre département Développement, nous recherchons un/e Concepteur-joaillier afin de définir et concevoir les produits finis en prenant en compte les contraintes technologiques, esthétiques, budgétaires et qualité. RESPONSABILITES Vous êtes chargé de réaliser un cahier des charges en intégrant les critères d’ergonomie, d’intégrité et de réparabilité d’un bijou exprimé par la Création, l’expert joaillier et le service client Vous retranscrivez le besoin de la Création (gouache) en un volume CAO en 3D suivant les standards de la Maison Cartier Vous êtes garant de la faisabilité lors de la conception du produit en collaboration avec les techniciens méthodes Vous présentez les prototypes en résines pour validation du concept par la Création Vous garantissez la conformité du prototype physique (or/platine) avant validation par la Création Vous présentez le prototype physique à la Création et argumenter des choix techniques si nécessaire Vous réalisez le dossier technique complet comprenant les volumes 3D (en suivant la méthodologie de dessin de la Maison Cartier), les mises en plan et chaînes de cotes garantissant le besoin exprimé dans le cahier des charges ainsi que les nomenclatures des produits (dossier de chaîne de cote avec 2D/3D) en collaboration avec les méthodes et la qualité Vous fournissez les données nécessaires à la création de références produits dans le PLM Vous participez à la fiabilisation et l’amélioration continue des produits CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en microtechnique, en mécanique, en conception ergonomique et design ou équivalent, avec une expérience confirmée de minium 3 ans, dans un poste similaire idéalement au sein d’un environnement industriel. Vous êtes à l’aise sur la CAO, idéalement sur CREO, vous avez une bonne maîtrise de la démarche d’analyse fonctionnelle et des chaînes de côte. Vous possédez de solides connaissances en assemblages techniques, intégrant les contraintes de faisabilité industrielle par usinage. Grâce à votre sens des priorités, vous êtes capable de gérer des projets de grande envergure et de travailler en toute autonomie. 
• Vos compétences en communication vous permettent de présenter et de défendre vos projets avec aisance lors des réunions. Grâce à votre flexibilité, votre rigueur et votre aptitude à établir des relations, vous entretenez des échanges fructueux avec les différentes interfaces. VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Notre équipe RH se tient à votre écoute, selon votre souhait et vos besoins, tout au long de votre expérience au sein de notre Maison. Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez notre HR Business Partner, et le/la Responsable du poste, et passerez des cas d’étude ou d’évaluation en fonction des besoins du poste. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier. jobs.description: Reference code: JR124793 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Rejoignez l’aventure d’une Manufacture axant son progrès sur l’adaptation permanente au besoin Client, la qualité et la fiabilité de ses produits et le développement de ses équipes. Un challenge passionnant pour une personne investie, motivée et dynamique La Manufacture Horlogère ValFleurier, filiale de Richemont International SA, développe et produit des kits et des mouvements horlogers. Elle intègre l’ensemble de ses métiers au sein de son site de Buttes (NE). Elle est aujourd’hui l’un des plus gros acteurs de son marché. La Manufacture s’appuie sur une organisation décentralisée au sein de laquelle les équipes s’impliquent dans une forte dynamique d’amélioration continue, avec des conditions de travail assurant la santé et la sécurité des collaborateurs. Nos engagements se traduisent par une politique RH centrée sur nos collaborateurs et leurs perspectives de carrière. Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons un(e) : APPRENTI(E) - CHARGE(E) DE PROJETS Santé Sécurité au Travail et Environnement (SSTE) (H/F/X) Poste basé à Buttes, dès septembre 2026 Au sein du service SSTE (Santé sécurité au travail et environnement) et dans le cadre de l’amélioration continue de notre système de management SSTE, vous apportez un soutien opérationnel au pilotage du déploiement de l’ISO 14001, 45001 et 50001. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Vous serez en charge des tâches suivantes : Conseiller et soutenir le Responsable SSTE dans la mise en œuvre des objectifs SSTE de l’entreprise Identifier et évaluer les risques afin de suivre les actions nécessaires au maintien d’un environnement de travail sécurisé. Participer à la Gestion et le contrôle de nos stockages/armoires de nos chimiques Participer à des analyses de risque (de postes, environnemental, industriel, chimique…) et de conformité. Analyser les causes des évènements SST Soutenir le Responsable SSTE dans la formation des collaborateurs en matière de santé et de sécurité ainsi que de manière spécifique les formations aux dangers particuliers Suivre les points remontés par les collaborateurs et managers concernant la SSTE, et proposer des actions correctives et préventives Participer à l’élaboration du programme de visites terrain et suivi des actions Assurer une coordination avec les Services Techniques, pour le suivi des actions correctives et préventives Préparer et animer des campagnes de sécurité afin de sensibiliser nos collaborateurs Mettre à jour la gestion documentaire SST Assurer le suivi de la veille légale avec le Responsable SSTE Participer à des projets groupe en lien avec la SST Assurer l’accueil des nouveaux collaborateurs en matière de SST COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS RÉUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Vous êtes étudiant en école d’ingénieur ou master avec une spécialisation dans les domaines de la sécurité et de l’environnement. Un précédent stage dans ces domaines serait un plus. Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac +3 à Bac+5, orienté Santé Sécurité Environnement, Vous disposez d’une première expérience professionnelle en SSTE Vous avez d’excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, d'analyse et de synthèse, Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le Pack Office (notamment Power Point) et êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques, Vous êtes doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel, et d'une forte capacité d'adaptation, Vous êtes rigoureux(se), organisé(e), et pédagogue, Vous êtes force de proposition, Conditions de ce poste en alternance : Alternance sous contrat d'apprentissage ou contrat de professionnalisation, Alternance à pourvoir pour septembre 2026 pour une durée de 1 à 3 ans (en fonction du diplôme préparé), QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Rejoignez un environnement de travail stimulant où l'héritage de l'horlogerie de luxe rencontre l'innovation. Ce stage vous offre une immersion dans les processus santé, sécurité et environnement, ainsi que l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets stratégiques et d'améliorer la sécurité et la santé de nos collaborateurs. Bénéficiez d'une formation complète (métier & gestion de projet) et d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour atteindre vos objectifs. Nous valorisons l'autonomie et vous offrons un environnement où vous pourrez pleinement vous épanouir. Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature complète sur notre site de carrières. Si vous correspondez au profil recherché vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique avec notre équipe RH afin de convenir d’un entretien #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Chargé de Projets SSTE Save Buttes, Switzerland ValFleurier Stagiaire Chargé de Projets Process Save Buttes, Switzerland ValFleurier Chef de Projets Services Techniques Save Buttes, Switzerland ValFleurier

jobs.title: Logistics Manufacturing Tech Team Lead
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR124697 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures transition into Industry 4.0 tools and practices” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with Industry 4.0 to accelerate digitalization and support more connected operational use cases bringing more efficiency and quality, based on latest technologies for Industrial IoT, Automation, No/Low Coding platforms and Analytics. The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Logistic Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Logistic Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Logistic such as Inbound/Outbound process, inventory management, production integration. This scope is covered by SAP EWM used as a back-End Warehouse Management System, which is exposed to various Logistic Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Logistic as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & WMS from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP ERP & EWM, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first Technical interview with the Manufacturing Product Area Manager and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with him/her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Manufacturing Processes Definition & Integration Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR124697 Richemont possiede alcune delle più importanti Maison di beni di lusso al mondo, con punti di forza particolari in gioielleria, orologi di alta gamma e accessori di lusso. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont si impegna a preservare il patrimonio e l’identità di ciascuna di esse. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maisons, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. "Unisciti a un ambiente dinamico di Tecnologia e Business per aiutare le nostre Manifatture a passare a strumenti e pratiche Industry 4.0" CONTEXT Le nostre Manifatture hanno intrapreso un percorso con Industry 4.0 per accelerare la digitalizzazione e supportare casi d’uso operativi più connessi, portando maggiore efficienza e qualità, basandosi sulle ultime tecnologie per Industrial IoT, Automazione, piattaforme No/Low Coding e Analytics. L’ambito delle nostre operazioni di produzione copre oltre 30 siti in Europa, di cui più di 20 in Svizzera, con attività principalmente legate all’orologeria e alla gioielleria, dal metodo tradizionale a pratiche più industrializzate. COME AVRAI IMPATTO? Il ruolo è inserito nel Dominio di Prodotto Tecnologico del Gruppo Richemont "Operations & Services" e fa parte dell’Area di Prodotto Manufacturing. Come Responsabile Tecnico del Team Manufacturing Logistico, tu e il tuo team sarete responsabili dell’analisi, progettazione, implementazione e supporto dei diversi componenti dell’Architettura delle Applicazioni di Manufacturing Logistico. Sarai responsabile dei miglioramenti e della consegna delle applicazioni secondo la roadmap del nostro “Product Owner” e le linee guida dei nostri Architetti. Il nostro ambito di Manufacturing Logistico include tutti i processi aziendali della catena del valore legati alla Logistica, come i processi Inbound/Outbound, gestione dell’inventario, integrazione della produzione. Questo ambito è coperto da SAP EWM, utilizzato come sistema di gestione magazzino back-end, esposto a vari front-end di esecuzione logistica. Questa strategia di decoupling è supportata in un panorama moderno basato su API e Architettura Event-Driven. Responsabilità Chiave: - Definire una Visione Tecnica e mantenere la roadmap in allineamento con la strategia di prodotto e l’architettura aziendale. - Gestire un Team Tecnologico di consulenti esperti nella progettazione, implementazione e supporto delle nostre soluzioni per le nostre Manifatture, secondo le pratiche Agile. - Guidare, sviluppare e motivare il team per proporre le migliori soluzioni e apprendere continuamente nuove competenze e tecnologie. - Garantire la conformità con i principi di architettura e sicurezza. - Preparare il Budget e pianificare la capacità del team per supportare tutte le iniziative richieste dalle nostre Maisons. - Collaborare e essere il punto di contatto principale per integrare con altri team su tutte le tematiche di integrazione. COME MISURERAI IL TUO SUCCESSO CON NOI? - Laurea magistrale / Ingegnere - Oltre 7 anni di esperienza, idealmente con un background di consulenza, in ambienti industriali nel settore Logistico e IT - Solida esperienza in ciclo completo di progetti, implementando ERP di produzione e WMS dalla progettazione all’esecuzione - Mentalità di leadership collaborativa e coaching. - Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni aziendali basate su SAP ERP & EWM, con esperienze MES, idealmente anche con piattaforme Low Code / No Code. - Buona comprensione dei principi di progettazione dell’architettura e delle tecnologie di integrazione come API. - Buona conoscenza del ciclo di vita di sviluppo software e personalizzazione in modelli Agile e Scrum. - Esperienza nella gestione di team, supervisionando attività di progettazione, implementazione e supporto, inclusa la gestione del budget e la pianificazione. - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione tecnica efficace con la direzione, i colleghi e i partner di settore. - Fluente in francese e inglese. COME TI FAREMO SORRIDERE? - Il ruolo rappresenta un mix perfetto tra progettare, costruire e mantenere nuove soluzioni, sviluppando e guidando un team agile esperto al servizio di tutte le nostre Maisons. - La varietà e la densità delle iniziative con le nostre Maisons offrono un ampio portafoglio di opportunità per imparare e sviluppare nuove competenze. - In Richemont possiamo e discutiamo con tutti i livelli di tecnologia e business, e il tuo valore aggiunto e i tuoi consigli sono molto apprezzati dagli stakeholder aziendali. IL TUO VIAGGIO CON NOI: 1. Se la tua candidatura sarà selezionata, ti contatteremo al più presto per una chiamata introduttiva informale. 2. Il passo successivo sarà un primo colloquio tecnico con il Responsabile dell’Area di Prodotto Manufacturing e, se ci sarà una corrispondenza, avrai un incontro personale con lui/lei e il nostro HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Jobs simili: Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont Definizione e Integrazione dei Processi di Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont

descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR124697 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüterhäuser, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, hochwertigen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jedes Haus repräsentiert eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst, und Richemont bemüht sich, das Erbe und die Identität jedes Hauses zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig setzen wir auf Innovation und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die mit den Werten unserer Maisons im Einklang stehen, durch einen kontinuierlichen Kreativitätsprozess. „Treten Sie in ein dynamisches Technologie- und Geschäftsumfeld ein, um unsere Manufakturen bei der Umstellung auf Industry 4.0-Tools und -Praktiken zu unterstützen“ KONTEXT Unsere Manufakturen haben sich auf eine Reise mit Industry 4.0 begeben, um die Digitalisierung zu beschleunigen und mehr vernetzte operative Anwendungsfälle zu unterstützen, die Effizienz und Qualität steigern, basierend auf den neuesten Technologien für Industrial IoT, Automatisierung, No/Low-Code-Plattformen und Analytics. Der Umfang unserer Fertigungsbetriebe umfasst über 30 Standorte in Europa, davon mehr als 20 in der Schweiz, mit Aktivitäten hauptsächlich im Bereich Uhren- und Schmuckherstellung, vom traditionellen bis zum stärker industrialisierten Ansatz. WIE WIRST DU EINEN IMPACT HABEN? Die Rolle ist im Group Technology Product Domain „Operations & Services“ eingebettet und Teil des Manufacturing Product Area. Als Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead bist du und dein Team verantwortlich für Analyse, Design, Deployment und Support der verschiedenen Komponenten unserer Logistik-Produktarchitektur. Du bist verantwortlich für Verbesserungen und die Lieferung der Anwendungen gemäß der Roadmap unseres „Product Owner“ und den Richtlinien unserer Architekten. Unser Logistik-Produktionsbereich umfasst alle Geschäftsprozesse der Wertschöpfungskette im Zusammenhang mit Logistik, wie Inbound/Outbound-Prozesse, Bestandsverwaltung und Produktionsintegration. Dieser Bereich wird durch SAP EWM als Backend-Lagerverwaltungssystem abgedeckt, das an verschiedene Front-End-Systeme für die Logistik ausgegeben wird. Diese Decoupling-Strategie wird in einer modernen Landschaft mit APIs und Event-Driven-Architektur unterstützt. Wichtige Verantwortlichkeiten: - Entwicklung einer technischen Vision und Pflege der Roadmap in Abstimmung mit der Produktstrategie und der Unternehmensarchitektur. - Leitung eines erfahrenen Technologie-Teams bei der Gestaltung, Implementierung und Unterstützung unserer Lösungen für die Manufakturen, nach agilen Prinzipien. - Führung, Entwicklung und Motivation des Teams, um die besten Lösungen vorzuschlagen und kontinuierlich neue Fähigkeiten und Technologien zu erlernen. - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Architektur- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien. - Budgetplanung und Kapazitätsplanung des Teams zur Unterstützung aller Initiativen unserer Maisons. - Zusammenarbeit und zentrale Kontaktstelle für die Integration mit anderen Teams bei allen Integrationsfragen. WIE WIRST DU ERFOLG HABEN? - Master-Abschluss / Ingenieur - Mehr als 7 Jahre Erfahrung, idealerweise mit Beratungshintergrund, in industriellen Umgebungen im Bereich Logistik und IT - Umfangreiche Erfahrung im gesamten Projektlebenszyklus bei der Implementierung von Manufacturing ERP & WMS, von Design bis Betrieb - Kollaborative Führungs- und Coaching-Mentalität - Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Geschäftslösungen auf SAP ERP & EWM, mit MES-Erfahrungen, idealerweise auch mit Low Code / No Code Plattformen - Gutes Verständnis von Architekturdesignprinzipien und Integrationstechnologien wie APIs - Kenntnisse im Softwareentwicklungs- und Customizing-Lifecycle in Agile- und Scrum-Modellen - Erfahrung in der Teamleitung, inklusive Budgetüberwachung und Planung - Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten, technische Informationen effektiv an Management, Kollegen und Branchenpartner zu kommunizieren - Fließend in Französisch und Englisch WIE WERDEN WIR DICH GLÜCKLICH MACHEN? - Die Rolle ist eine perfekte Mischung aus Design, Aufbau und Wartung neuer Lösungen, während du ein erfahrenes agiles Team leitest, das allen unseren Maisons dient. - Die Vielfalt und Dichte der Initiativen mit unseren Maisons bieten ein großes Portfolio an Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. - Bei Richemont können wir auf allen Ebenen mit Technologie und Business sprechen, und dein Mehrwert sowie deine Ratschläge werden von den Stakeholdern sehr geschätzt. DEIN WEG MIT UNS: 1. Wenn deine Bewerbung ausgewählt wird, werden wir uns so schnell wie möglich mit dir für ein informelles Einführungsgespräch in Verbindung setzen. 2. Der nächste Schritt ist ein erstes technisches Interview mit dem Manufacturing Product Area Manager. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence : JR124697 Richemont possède certaines des Maisons de luxe les plus prestigieuses au monde, avec des forces particulières dans la joaillerie, les montres de luxe et les accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une tradition fière de style, de qualité et d’artisanat, et Richemont s’engage à préserver le patrimoine et l’identité de chacune d’elles. En même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l’innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits en accord avec les valeurs de nos Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. « Rejoignez un environnement dynamique de Technologie et de Business pour aider nos Manufactures à passer aux outils et pratiques Industry 4.0 » CONTEXTE Nos Manufactures ont entamé un parcours avec Industry 4.0 pour accélérer la digitalisation et soutenir des cas d’usage opérationnels plus connectés, apportant plus d’efficacité et de qualité, en s’appuyant sur les dernières technologies pour l’IoT industriel, l’automatisation, les plateformes No/Low Code et l’Analytics. Le périmètre de nos opérations de fabrication couvre plus de 30 sites en Europe, dont plus de 20 en Suisse, avec des activités principalement liées à l’horlogerie et à la joaillerie, du traditionnel à des pratiques plus industrialisées. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Le rôle s’inscrit dans le domaine de produit technologique du Groupe Richemont « Operations & Services » et fait partie de la zone de produit Manufacturing. En tant que Responsable Technique de l’Équipe Manufacturing Logistique, vous et votre équipe serez responsables de l’analyse, de la conception, du déploiement et du support des différents composants de notre architecture applicative logistique. Vous serez responsable des améliorations et de la livraison des applications selon la feuille de route de notre « Product Owner » et les lignes directrices de nos Architectes. Notre périmètre de Manufacturing Logistique inclut tous les processus métier de la chaîne de valeur liés à la logistique, tels que les processus inbound/outbound, la gestion des stocks et l’intégration de la production. Ce périmètre est couvert par SAP EWM, utilisé comme système de gestion d’entrepôt back-end, exposé à divers front-ends d’exécution logistique. Cette stratégie de découplage est soutenue dans un paysage moderne basé sur des API et une architecture événementielle. Responsabilités clés : - Définir une vision technique et maintenir la feuille de route en alignement avec la stratégie produit et l’architecture d’entreprise. - Gérer une équipe technologique expérimentée dans la conception, le déploiement et le support de nos solutions pour nos Manufactures, selon les pratiques Agile. - Diriger, développer et motiver votre équipe pour proposer les meilleures solutions et apprendre continuellement de nouvelles compétences et technologies. - Assurer la conformité avec les règles d’architecture et de sécurité. - Préparer le budget et planifier la capacité de votre équipe pour soutenir toutes les initiatives demandées par nos Maisons. - Collaborer et être le point de contact principal pour l’intégration avec d’autres équipes sur toutes les questions d’intégration. COMMENT MESURER LE SUCCÈS AVEC NOUS ? - Diplôme de Master / Ingénieur - Plus de 7 ans d’expérience, idéalement avec une expérience en conseil, dans des environnements industriels en Logistique et IT - Solide expérience dans le cycle complet de projets déployant ERP de fabrication et WMS, de la conception à l’exploitation - Esprit de leadership collaboratif et de coaching - Expérience dans la conception de solutions métier basées sur SAP ERP & EWM, avec des expériences MES, idéalement aussi avec des plateformes Low Code / No Code - Bonne compréhension des principes de conception d’architecture et des technologies d’intégration telles que les API - Bonne connaissance du cycle de vie du développement logiciel et de la personnalisation en modèles Agile et Scrum - Expérience en gestion d’équipe, incluant le suivi du budget et la planification - Excellentes capacités à communiquer efficacement des informations techniques à la direction, aux collègues et aux partenaires industriels - Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais COMMENT NOUS VOUS FERONS RÊVER ? - Le rôle est un parfait mélange entre la conception, la construction et la maintenance de nouvelles solutions, tout en développant et en dirigeant une équipe agile expérimentée au service de toutes nos Maisons. - La variété et la densité des initiatives avec nos Maisons offrent un large portefeuille d’opportunités pour apprendre et développer de nouvelles compétences. - Chez Richemont, nous pouvons et discutons avec tous les niveaux de technologie et de business, et votre valeur ajoutée ainsi que vos conseils sont très appréciés par les parties prenantes. VOTRE PARCOURS AVEC NOUS : 1. Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous contacterons dès que possible pour un appel de présentation informel. 2. La prochaine étape sera un premier entretien technique avec le responsable de la zone de produit Manufacturing, et si cela correspond, vous rencontrerez personnellement lui/elle et notre partenaire RH. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Jobs similaires : Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Sauvegarder Meyrin, Suisse Richemont Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Sauvegarder Meyrin, Suisse Richemont Définition et Intégration des Processus de Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Sauvegarder Meyrin, Suisse Richemont

BACKGROUND Richemont International Distribution sta reclutando per il suo centro di distribuzione a Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Pick & Pack. Sarai responsabile della corretta esecuzione e conformità delle operazioni Pick & Pack in base alle normative e alle direttive, nonché della gestione operativa del team. Come farai ad avere un IMPACT?
• I tuoi compiti principali saranno i seguenti: Grazie alla vostra relazione costruttiva e all'orientamento dei risultati, potete creare le condizioni giuste per portare il vostro team di operatori logistici a raggiungere gli obiettivi di qualità, costo, ritardo e sicurezza. Li supporti ogni giorno nella realizzazione della loro attività allenando e animando le prestazioni. Ti piace lavorare nel campo, nel cuore delle attività, in un ambiente dinamico e impegnativo e sono disposti a lavorare come squadra nel pomeriggio (13h-22h). jobs.description:
Reference code: JR125127 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures Planning Teams with solutions to improve their operational excellence” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with to accelerate digitalization and support more precise, data driven, operational inputs, based on latest technologies for Industrial Manufacturing & Analytics The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As Upstream Supply Chain Planning Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Applications supporting Planning in Manufacturing, for Strategic, Tactical and Operational planning horizons. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Upstream Supply Chain Planning includes all business processes of the value chain related to Planning for Manufacturing & Subcontracting Activities (from S&OP, MPS, MRP to handover with Operations), and its deep integration with Manufacturing & Supply Chain operations. This scope requires specialized solutions as back-end like SAP PP, APO PP-DS and Anaplan, as well as Detailed Scheduling best of breed solutions, and Data Analytics Platforms. Our technology stack is based on a modern landscape leveraging on APIs and Event Driven Architecture for more real-time execution data driven decisions and performance management. Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer with strong emphasis in Supply Chain Planning & Manufacturing 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Production as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR125127 Richemont possiede alcune delle Maison di beni di lusso più prestigiose al mondo, con punti di forza particolari in gioielleria, orologi di alta gamma e accessori di lusso. L’ambito delle nostre operazioni di produzione copre oltre 30 siti in Europa, di cui più di 20 in Svizzera, con attività principalmente legate all’orologeria e alla gioielleria, dal metodo tradizionale a pratiche più industrializzate. Come Responsabile Tecnico del Team di Pianificazione della Supply Chain a Monte, tu e il tuo team sarete responsabili dell’analisi, progettazione, implementazione e supporto delle diverse componenti delle nostre applicazioni di supporto alla pianificazione in ambito produttivo, per orizzonti strategici, tattici e operativi. Questo ambito richiede soluzioni specializzate come back-end quali SAP PP, APO PP-DS e Anaplan, oltre a soluzioni di pianificazione dettagliata e piattaforme di analisi dei dati. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR125127 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüterhäuser, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, hochwertigen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Der Umfang unserer Fertigungsaktivitäten umfasst über 30 Standorte in Europa, davon mehr als 20 in der Schweiz, mit Aktivitäten hauptsächlich im Bereich Uhren- und Schmuckherstellung, vom traditionellen Ansatz bis zu stärker industrialisierten Praktiken. Als Technischer Leiter des Upstream Supply Chain Planning Teams bist du gemeinsam mit deinem Team verantwortlich für Analyse, Design, Implementierung und Support der verschiedenen Komponenten unserer Anwendungen, die die Planung in der Fertigung unterstützen, für strategische, taktische und operative Planungshorizonte. jobs.description: Reference code: JR125044 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Correspondez vous au profil ? Vous disposez d’une expérience en construction de mouvements horlogers. Votre esprit méthodique, votre curiosité et votre créativité vous permettent de mener à bien des projets innovants en lien avec l’identité de la Maison. Vous maîtrisez la micromécanique (ou un domaine équivalent en mécanique de précision ou technologie horlogère) ainsi qu'un logiciel de CAO. Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Rattaché(e) au Directeur Recherche & Développement Horlogerie, le Constructeur Mouvement (H/F) développe des mouvements ou mécanismes ainsi que les dossiers techniques associés, à destination de l'horlogerie et à la Mécanique d'Art de la Maison. Les développements sont menés en lien avec l'ensemble des acteurs concernés des Ateliers Horlogers (Meyrin & Ste Croix), du département Objet Extraordinaires à Paris, des partenaires externes. Dans le cadre de vos missions vous serez en charge de : Concevoir et développer des mouvements horlogers, de la phase de concept à la production. Réaliser des études de faisabilité et des analyses techniques. Élaborer des plans de construction détaillés et des nomenclatures. Effectuer des simulations et des tests pour valider les performances et la fiabilité des mouvements. Collaborer avec le studio de design, le bureau d'habillage (boîtier) et les autres constructeurs (boîtier, cadran et mouvement) pour assurer la mise en œuvre des nouveaux mouvements. Suivre l'évolution des technologies et des matériaux dans le domaine de l'horlogerie. Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de conception. Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière ! Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c’est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition. Dès votre intégration, vous serez immergé(e) dans l’univers de la Maison grâce à des formations sur notre histoire, notre savoir-faire et notre culture. Le processus de recrutement Postulez directement en ligne. Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l'équipe RH pour un entretien. Vous rencontrerez le Directeur Recherche & Développement Horlogerie, puis la Responsable des Ressources Humaines. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR125044 Chi siamo? Una Maison di Alta Gioielleria con una forte eredità che promuove un know-how eccezionale in un ambiente incantevole e creativo. La nostra Maison cerca talenti che contribuiscano allo sviluppo e alla trasmissione delle loro competenze con cura e senza compromessi. Da Van Cleef & Arpels sarai circondato da esperti appassionati e contribuirai a molti nuovi progetti che permettono alla nostra Maison di reinventarsi regolarmente. In Van Cleef & Arpels siamo orgogliosi di assumere talenti provenienti da background e esperienze diverse. Crediamo che quando diversità e inclusione sono pienamente abbracciate e valorizzate, la creatività e la sapere emergono per offrire eccellenza. Corresponde al profilo? Hai esperienza nella costruzione di movimenti orologieri. Il tuo spirito metodico, curiosità e creatività ti permettono di portare avanti progetti innovativi in linea con l’identità della Maison. Hai competenze in micromeccanica (o un campo equivalente in meccanica di precisione o tecnologia orologiera) e conosci un software CAD. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? Sotto la direzione del Direttore Ricerca & Sviluppo Orologeria, il Costruttore Movimento (H/F) sviluppa movimenti o meccanismi e i relativi dossier tecnici destinati all’orologeria e alla Meccanica d’Arte della Maison. Gli sviluppi sono condotti in collaborazione con tutti gli attori coinvolti degli Ateliers Horlogers (Meyrin & Ste Croix), del dipartimento Objet Extraordinaires a Parigi, e partner esterni. Nel quadro delle tue missioni sarai responsabile di: - Progettare e sviluppare movimenti orologieri, dalla fase di concept alla produzione. - Realizzare studi di fattibilità e analisi tecniche. - Elaborare piani di costruzione dettagliati e distinte base. - Effettuare simulazioni e test per validare le prestazioni e l’affidabilità dei movimenti. - Collaborare con lo studio di design, l’ufficio di incastonatura (cassa) e gli altri costruttori (cassa, quadrante e movimento) per garantire l’implementazione dei nuovi movimenti. - Seguire l’evoluzione delle tecnologie e dei materiali nel settore dell’orologeria. - Partecipare al miglioramento continuo dei processi di progettazione. Più che per una posizione… stiamo reclutando per una carriera! Entrare in Van Cleef & Arpels significa prima di tutto unirsi a un team dove lo sviluppo dei collaboratori è al centro della nostra ambizione. Reference code: JR125044 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Does this profile match you? You have experience in watch movement construction. Your methodical mindset, curiosity, and creativity enable you to successfully lead innovative projects aligned with the Maison’s identity. You are proficient in micromechanics (or an equivalent field in precision mechanics or watchmaking technology) and CAD software. What do we expect from you? Reporting to the Director of Watch Research & Development, the Movement Builder (H/F) develops movements or mechanisms and the associated technical files for watchmaking and the Maison’s Art Mechanics. Developments are carried out in collaboration with all relevant stakeholders from the Watchmaking Workshops (Meyrin & Ste Croix), the Object Extraordinary department in Paris, and external partners.
• Your responsibilities will include: - Designing and developing watch movements from concept to production. - Conducting feasibility studies and technical analyses. - Preparing detailed construction plans and bills of materials. - Performing simulations and tests to validate performance and reliability. - Collaborating with the design studio, casing department (case), and other builders (case, dial, and movement) to ensure the implementation of new movements. - Keeping up with technological and material advancements in watchmaking. - Participating in continuous improvement of design processes. More than just a position… we are recruiting for a career! Joining Van Cleef & Arpels means becoming part of a team where the development of employees is at the heart of our ambition. From your onboarding, you will be immersed in the Maison’s universe through training on our history, expertise, and culture. The recruitment process: Apply directly online. If your profile is selected, you will be contacted by the HR team for an interview. You will meet the Director of Watch R&D, followed by the Human Resources Manager. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR125355 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. As the Group Talent Systems & Operations Manager, you will be a key member of the Group Talent team, reporting to the Group Talent Operations Senior Manager in Geneva. This role requires a strong blend of operational expertise and project coordination, focusing on managing initiatives related to talent and performance. Your primary mission will be to optimize our HR Talent systems, particularly Workday, from a business perspective, ensuring data integrity, driving efficiency, enhancing user experience, and providing expert support to the HR community, while actively contributing to and coordinating various projects that enhance our talent landscape. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Key 
• Responsibilities: System Optimization & Project Coordination: Proactively identify opportunities and collaborate with cross functional and HRIS teams to coordinate and manage enhancement projects within Workday, focusing on improving functionality, efficiency, and user experience for Talent, Performance, and Development modules. Act as a primary point of contact and expert resource for the Talent community regarding Workday usage and optimization processes. Manage the effective resolution of system support needs by partnering with HRIS teams, including the escalation of complex or critical issues, and contribute to the planning and execution of system-related initiatives. Data Management & Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough and systematic testing of Talent, Performance, and Development processes and functionalities within Workday across various test environments, identifying bugs and verifying fixes to ensure smooth operation and data integrity. Assist in the implementation of new reports and analytics capabilities, coordinating with stakeholders to ensure they meet business requirements and provide reliable insights. Learning & Development Support & Communication: Proactively create, maintain, and update engaging e-learning materials (courses, videos, presentations) for HR Academy / NeverStopLearning, adapting to evolving needs and framework changes using tools such as EasyGenerator, Canva, and PowerPoint. Participate in communication efforts related to managing the talent optimization cycle (Talent, Performance, Development), ensuring clarity and engagement within the HR community. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Your 
• Profile: You should have 10 years of international HR experience, with a strong focus on HR systems optimization (especially Workday), data quality, and operational support within Talent Management. You are autonomous, professional, and capable of driving system improvements. Required Skills: Workday Expertise: Deep understanding and hands-on experience with Workday (Talent, Performance, Development modules) from a business perspective. Business-System Acumen: Ability to translate business needs into system requirements and collaborate with HRIS teams. Digital Savvy: Proficient in e-learning authoring tools (e.g., EasyGenerator, Canva, PowerPoint). Operational Excellence: Strong commitment to improving quality and efficiency of business and system processes. Problem-Solving & Proactivity: Analytical approach to identifying and resolving system anomalies and process inefficiencies. Project Management: Ability to coordinate and manage projects, contribute to larger initiatives, and manage multiple priorities effectively. Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and oral communication, with the ability to build relationships. Attention to Detail: Meticulous in content validation, system testing, and data quality assurance. Global Mindset: Experience in a global, matrixed environment. Language: Fluent in English, any other language is a plus. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? By providing you great opportunities to become a part of a dynamic and diverse environment where passion is not scarce and where you can count on the team to go that extra mile with you to reach success. This position will also be your opportunity to deepen your knowledge of several Talent processes on a global scale, while thinking about the future with the people in the center. Finally, the Richemont Group offers plenty of opportunities to ensure a healthy and progressive career development for you in the future. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs HRIS Specialist – CDD Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Director, Talent Management & Mobility Save New York, United States of America Cartier Senior Manager, Talent Corporate & Early Career, Cartier Save New York, United States of America Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR125355 Richemont possiede alcune delle Maison di lusso più prestigiose al mondo, con punti di forza in gioielleria, orologi di alta gamma e accessori di alta qualità. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont si impegna a preservare il patrimonio e l’identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. (CONTRATTO A TEMPO DETERMINATO) COME AVRAI IMPATTO? Come Responsabile Progetti Sistemi e Operazioni Talent di Gruppo, sarai un membro chiave del team Talent di Gruppo, riportando al Senior Manager delle Operazioni Talent di Gruppo a Ginevra. Il tuo obiettivo principale sarà ottimizzare i nostri sistemi HR Talent, in particolare Workday, dal punto di vista aziendale, garantendo l’integrità dei dati e supportando le iniziative di Learning & Development. Potenzierai l’efficienza, migliorerai l’esperienza utente e fornirai supporto esperto alla comunità HR. In questo ruolo, le tue principali responsabilità saranno: Ottimizzazione e Supporto del Sistema: Identificare proattivamente opportunità e collaborare con i team HRIS per risolvere anomalie di sistema e guidare progetti di miglioramento di piccola scala all’interno di Workday, focalizzandoti sul miglioramento delle funzionalità, dell’efficienza e dell’esperienza utente per i moduli Talent, Performance e Development. Agirai anche come punto di contatto principale e risorsa esperta per la comunità Talent riguardo all’uso e all’ottimizzazione di Workday, coordinando la risoluzione dei ticket di supporto con i team HRIS e escalando le problematiche critiche quando necessario. Gestione dei Dati e Assicurazione della Qualità: Condurre test approfonditi e sistematici dei processi e delle funzionalità Talent, Performance e Development in Workday su vari ambienti di test, identificando bug e verificando le correzioni per garantire un funzionamento fluido e l’integrità dei dati. Inoltre, assisterai nell’implementazione di nuovi report e condurrai test completi per assicurarti che soddisfino i requisiti aziendali e forniscano insights affidabili. Supporto a Learning & Development: Creare, mantenere e aggiornare materiali di e-learning coinvolgenti (corsi, video, presentazioni) per HR Academy / NeverStopLearning, adattandoti alle esigenze in evoluzione e ai cambiamenti del framework utilizzando strumenti come EasyGenerator, Canva e PowerPoint. Parteciperai anche alle attività di comunicazione relative alla gestione del ciclo di ottimizzazione del talento (Talent, Performance, Development), assicurando chiarezza e coinvolgimento all’interno della comunità HR. COME MISURERAI IL TUO SUCCESSO CON NOI? Dovresti avere almeno 10 anni di esperienza HR internazionale, con forte focus sull’ottimizzazione dei sistemi HR (specialmente Workday), sulla qualità dei dati e sul supporto operativo nel Talent Management. Sei autonomo, professionale e capace di guidare miglioramenti di sistema. Tu: - Esperienza approfondita con Workday: conoscenza e pratica diretta dei moduli Talent, Performance e Development da una prospettiva aziendale. - Competenza in sistemi aziendali: capacità di tradurre le esigenze di business in requisiti di sistema e collaborare con i team HRIS. - Competenza digitale: padronanza di strumenti di authoring e-learning (es. EasyGenerator, Canva, PowerPoint). - Eccellenza operativa: forte impegno nel migliorare qualità ed efficienza dei processi aziendali e di sistema. - Problem-solving e proattività: approccio analitico nell’identificazione e risoluzione di anomalie di sistema e inefficienze di processo. - Gestione di progetti: capacità di guidare o contribuire a progetti di piccola scala e gestire priorità multiple. - Competenze comunicative e relazionali: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale, con capacità di costruire relazioni. - Attenzione ai dettagli: meticoloso nella validazione dei contenuti, test di sistema e assicurazione della qualità dei dati. - Mentalità globale: esperienza in un ambiente globale e matriciale. - Lingua: fluente in inglese, qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus. COSA RENDIAMO IL NOSTRO GRUPPO DIVERSO? La nostra vera forza non risiede nelle somiglianze, ma nella ricchezza delle arti, culture e competenze umane, nonché nella nostra capacità specifica di coltivare potenziale inesplorato. - Valorizziamo libertà, collegialità, lealtà e solidarietà. - Promuoviamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità. - Ci prendiamo cura del mondo in cui viviamo. IL TUO VIAGGIO CON NOI Se la tua candidatura sarà selezionata, ti contatteremo a breve per una chiamata introduttiva. Come parte del processo di colloquio, garantiamo sempre completa trasparenza e chiarezza, cioè avrai l’opportunità di incontrare persone che saranno cruciali per il tuo successo futuro nel ruolo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Jobs simili HR Senior Project & Portfolio Manager Salva Bellinzona, Svizzera Richemont HR MANAGER - OPERATIONS DEL PERSONALE Salva Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, Cina Richemont Talent Management & Acquisition Manager Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Jaeger-LeCoultre

(BEFRISTETER VERTRAG) WIE WIRST DU EINEN BEITRAG LEISTEN? Als Gruppentalent-System- & Operations-Projektmanager bist du ein Schlüsselmitglied des Group Talent Teams und berichtest an den Senior Manager Group Talent Operations in Genf. Dein Hauptziel ist es, unsere HR Talent-Systeme, insbesondere Workday, aus geschäftlicher Sicht zu optimieren, Datenintegrität sicherzustellen und Lern- & Entwicklungsinitiativen zu unterstützen. Du wirst Effizienz steigern, die Nutzererfahrung verbessern und fachkundige Unterstützung für die HR-Community bieten. In dieser Rolle umfassen deine Hauptverantwortlichkeiten: Systemoptimierung & Support: Proaktiv Chancen erkennen und mit HRIS-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um Systemanomalien zu beheben und kleinere Verbesserungsprojekte innerhalb von Workday voranzutreiben, mit Fokus auf die Verbesserung der Funktionalität, Effizienz und Nutzererfahrung der Module Talent, Performance und Development.
