"La nostra missione è quella di trasformare le complesse capacità cloud e DevOps in esperienze di auto-servizio semplici che consentano alle squadre di innovare più velocemente e in modo più sicuro" (Michelle Daalman, - DevOps Services Team) Come stagista DevOps Services Engineering presso Richemont, contribuirete all'evoluzione del nostro Internal Developer Portal (IDP) costruendo componenti, interfacce di servizio e flussi di lavoro di auto-servizio che consentono alle squadre interne di utilizzare facilmente i servizi cloud e DevOps automatizzati. Si tratta di uno stage pratico progettato per gli entusiasti che vogliono sviluppare solide basi in cloud, DevOps e automazione, mentre contribuiscono a iniziative significative utilizzate da squadre client reali. Durante il tuo stage, ti aspettano:
• Assistere nella costruzione e miglioramento delle pipeline CI/CD che supportano la consegna del portale e dei servizi
• Scrivere e mantenere script o servizi per supportare l'automazione e le integrazioni
• Collaborare con le squadre di sviluppo per automatizzare i flussi di lavoro e i processi di distribuzione
• Contribuire alla creazione di servizi automatizzati, riutilizzabili e confezionati, esposti attraverso il portale
• Lavora con tecnologie container come Docker e Kubernetes
• Esponi alle piattaforme cloud (AWS, GCP, Alicloud)
• Identificare proattivamente le lacune, suggerire miglioramenti e contribuire con idee per migliorare l'esperienza degli sviluppatori
• Documentare processi, strumenti e best practice per uso interno
• Applicare le best practice DevOps per garantire affidabilità, coerenza e trasparenza Collaborare con le squadre di infrastruttura cloud, piattaforma DevOps e governance e architettura cloud per ottimizzare la configurazione e migliorare l'efficienza, la governance e la sicurezza dei deploy Mantenersi aggiornati sulle tecnologie cloud e DevOps emergenti
• Sei uno studente o un giovane ingegnera che:
• Sta attualmente frequentando (o ha recentemente completato) un corso di laurea in Scienze Informatiche, IT o un campo affine
• Ha esperienza pratica con i linguaggi di scripting
• Ha un forte interesse per DevOps, piattaforme cloud, automazione o ingegneria delle piattaforme
• Si sente a proprio agio nel lavorare con le API e i concetti di sviluppo web moderni
• Ha conoscenze basilari delle pipeline CI/CD, dei flussi di lavoro basati su Git o delle pratiche DevOps
• Ha una conoscenza introduttiva dei container (Docker, Kubernetes) e/o dei concetti di cloud
• E curioso, proattivo e desideroso di imparare oltre lo sviluppo frontend

descriptionByLocale.en: Reference code: JR128572 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. "Our mission is to turn complex cloud and DevOps capabilities into simple, self-service experiences that let teams innovate faster and safer" (Michelle Daalman, - DevOps Services Team) ABOUT THE ROLE As a DevOps Services Engineering Intern at Richemont, you will contribute to the evolution of our Internal Developer Portal (IDP) by building components, service interfaces, and self-service workflows that enable internal teams to easily consume automated cloud and DevOps services. This is a hands-on internship designed for enthusiastic learners who want to develop strong foundations in Cloud, DevOps, and automation, while contributing to meaningfull initiatives used by real client teams. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to help streamline workflows, improve deployment practices, and enhance developer self-service capabilities using modern DevOps and cloud technologies. WHAT YOU WILL DO During your internship, you will: Assist in building and improving CI/CD pipelines supporting portal and service delivery Write and maintain scripts or services to support automation and integrations Collaborate with development teams to automate workflows and deployment processes Contribute to the creation of packaged, reusable automated services exposed through the portal Work with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Gain exposure to Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP, Alicloud) Proactively identify gaps, suggest improvements, and contribute ideas to enhance developer experience Document processes, tools, and best practices for internal use. Apply DevOps best practices to ensure reliability, consistency, and transparency Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Platform, and Cloud Governance & Architecture teams to optimize configuration and enhance deployment efficiency, governance & security Stay up to date with emerging Cloud and DevOps technologies WHO YOU ARE You are a student or junior engineer who: Is currently pursuing (or recently completed) a degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field Has hands-on experience with scripting languages Has a strong interest in DevOps, cloud platforms, automation, or platform engineering Is comfortable working with APIs and modern web development concepts Has basic knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, or DevOps practices Has introductory exposure to containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and / or cloud concepts Is curious, proactive, and eager to learn beyond frontend development Communicates clearly and enjoys working in cross-functional teams HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? In a young and dynamic team environment focused on mentoring and personal development, you will participate in our digital transformation journey at Richemont Group. jobs.title: Heritage Project Manager (maternity cover)
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128553 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Heritage Project Manager, you will be responsible for the preservation, management, and promotion of Piaget's private collection. This includes historical timepieces, documents, designs, and other artifacts that represent the brand's rich heritage. The role encompasses collection management, exhibition development, documentation, authentication support, and contributing to the overall heritage strategy of Piaget. Key responsibilities: Piaget Private Collection Management: Manage the inventory, cataloguing, storage, and restoration of the Piaget private collection. Oversee strategic acquisitions for the collection, aligning with heritage strategy and monitoring auctions. Create and maintain a comprehensive database for all collection items, including descriptions, provenance, images, and condition reports. Promote the Piaget heritage collection through online platforms, social media, and public events. Exhibition Development: Plan, develop, and execute engaging heritage exhibitions for the Piaget Retail Network and external venues. Collaborate with curators and designers to create compelling exhibition narratives and displays. Manage all exhibition logistics, including transportation, installation, and de-installation of collection items. Knowledge Transmission & Heritage Strategy: Contribute to educational materials and publications related to Piaget heritage. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Piaget's history, production techniques, and design evolution. Play a key role in the development and implementation of Piaget's overall heritage strategy. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in History, Art History, Museum Studies, or a closely related field. Professional Experience: Proven experience in heritage management, museum curation, or auction houses, with a strong preference for candidates from the luxury goods industry. Specialized Expertise: In-depth knowledge of horology, the history of watchmaking, and robust understanding of collection management principles and best practices. Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience in exhibition development and comprehensive project management. Communication & Language: Exceptional research, writing, and communication skills, coupled with fluency in both English and French (written and spoken). Technical Proficiency: Proficient in database management and digital asset management systems. Interpersonal Attributes: An agile, flexible team player, adept at fostering relationships within a multinational and culturally diverse environment. Possesses a high level of ethics, strong values, and an unwavering commitment to confidentiality. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! descriptionByLocale.de: Bezugscode: JR128553 Umgeben von seiner Familie und geleitet von seiner starken unternehmerischen Denkweise beschloss Georges-Edouard Piaget 1874, eine Uhrmacherwerkstatt in La Côte-aux-Fées zu gründen, einem kleinen Dorf inmitten der Schweizer Berge des Jura. Seit diesem Tag hat Piaget die Grenzen für "Tun, was noch nie zuvor getan wurde" erweitert und fertigt anspruchsvolle und extravagante Uhren und Schmuckkreationen. In den Mauern unserer Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire nutzen unsere Handwerksmeister weiterhin seltene Fähigkeiten, die von Generation zu Generation erhalten und perfektioniert wurden. Heute wird die außergewöhnliche Handwerkskunst von Piaget weltweit gefeiert, unterstützt durch eine starke globale Präsenz und ein engagiertes Netzwerk von Kunden- und Einzelhandelskollegen, die den Geist unseres Hauses jeden Tag zum Leben erwecken. WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND? Als Heritage Project Manager sind Sie für die Erhaltung, Verwaltung und Förderung der Privatsammlung von Piaget verantwortlich. Dazu gehören historische Zeitmesser, Dokumente, Designs und andere Artefakte, die das reiche Erbe der Marke repräsentieren. Die Rolle umfasst Sammlungsmanagement, Ausstellungsentwicklung, Dokumentation, Authentifizierungsunterstützung und einen Beitrag zur Gesamtstrategie von Piaget. Piaget Private Collection Management: Verwalten Sie das Inventar, die Katalogisierung, Lagerung und Wiederherstellung der Privatsammlung von Piaget. Beaufsichtigen Sie strategische Akquisitionen für die Sammlung, stimmen Sie mit der Heritage-Strategie überein und überwachen Sie Auktionen. Erstellen und pflegen Sie eine umfassende Datenbank für alle Sammlungselemente, einschließlich Beschreibungen, Herkunft, Bilder und Zustandsberichte. Fördern Sie die Piaget Heritage Collection durch Online-Plattformen, soziale Medien und öffentliche Veranstaltungen. Ausstellungsentwicklung: Planen, entwickeln und durchführen Sie interessante Ausstellungen für das Piaget Retail Network und externe Veranstaltungsorte. Arbeiten Sie mit Kuratoren und Designern zusammen, um überzeugende Ausstellungserzählungen und -displays zu erstellen. Verwalten Sie die gesamte Ausstellungslogistik, einschließlich Transport, Installation und Deinstallation von Sammlungsgegenständen. Knowledge Transmission & Heritage Strategy: Tragen Sie zu Bildungsmaterialien und Publikationen zum Piaget-Erbe bei. Behalten Sie ein umfassendes Wissen über Piagets Geschichte, Produktionstechniken und Designentwicklung bei. Spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Gesamtstrategie von Piaget. WIE ERFAHREN SIE ERFOLG MIT UNS? Gemeinsam. Wenn Sie ein Teil davon werden wollen, zögern Sie nicht, sich zu bewerben! descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR128553 Entouré de sa famille et guidé par son esprit d'entreprise fort, Georges-Édouard Piaget décide, en 1874, de créer un atelier d'horlogerie à La Côte-aux-Fées, petit village au milieu des montagnes suisses du Jura. Depuis ce jour, Piaget a poussé les limites à faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant. Dans les murs de nos Ateliers de l'Extraordinaire, nos maîtres artisans continuent d'exploiter des compétences rares qui ont été préservées et perfectionnées de génération en génération. Aujourd'hui, l'artisanat exceptionnel de Piaget est célébré dans le monde entier, soutenu par une forte présence mondiale et un réseau dédié de clients et de collègues de détail qui donnent vie à l'esprit de notre Maison chaque jour. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? En tant que gestionnaire de projet patrimonial, vous serez responsable de la conservation, de la gestion et de la promotion de la collection privée de Piaget. Cela comprend des montres historiques, des documents, des dessins et autres artefacts qui représentent le riche patrimoine de la marque. Ce rôle englobe la gestion de la collection, le développement d'expositions, la documentation, le soutien à l'authentification et la contribution à la stratégie patrimoniale globale de Piaget. Principales responsabilités : Piaget Private Collection Management : Gérer l'inventaire, le catalogage, le stockage et la restauration de la collection privée Piaget. Superviser les acquisitions stratégiques de la collection, s'aligner sur la stratégie patrimoniale et surveiller les enchères. Créer et tenir à jour une base de données complète pour tous les éléments de la collection, y compris les descriptions, la provenance, les images et les rapports d'état. Promouvoir la collection du patrimoine Piaget au moyen de plateformes en ligne, de médias sociaux et d'événements publics. Développement de l'exposition : Planifier, développer et exécuter des expositions patrimoniales pour le réseau Piaget Retail et des sites externes. Collaborer avec les conservateurs et les concepteurs pour créer des récits et des expositions fascinants. Gérer toute la logistique d'exposition, y compris le transport, l'installation et la désinstallation des objets de collection. Stratégie de transmission des connaissances et du patrimoine : Contribuer au matériel éducatif et aux publications liées au patrimoine Piaget. Maintenir une connaissance complète de l'histoire, des techniques de production et de l'évolution du design de Piaget. Jouer un rôle clé dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie patrimoniale globale de Piaget. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre ? Études : Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en histoire, histoire de l'art, études muséales ou domaine étroitement lié. Expérience professionnelle : Expérience éprouvée en gestion du patrimoine, en gestion de musée ou en vente aux enchères, avec une forte préférence pour les candidats de l'industrie des produits de luxe. Expertise spécialisée : Connaissance approfondie de l'horologie, de l'histoire de l'horlogerie et compréhension solide des principes de gestion de la collection et des meilleures pratiques. Leadership du projet : Expérience démontrée dans le développement d'expositions et la gestion complète du projet. Communication et langue : Compétences exceptionnelles en recherche, écriture et communication, associées à la maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (écrit et parlé). Compétences techniques : Connaissance des systèmes de gestion des bases de données et des actifs numériques. Attributs interpersonnels : Un joueur agile et flexible, capable de favoriser les relations dans un environnement multinational et culturel diversifié. Possède un haut niveau d'éthique, des valeurs fortes et un engagement indéfectible en faveur de la confidentialité. J'aimerais encore savoir pourquoi tu te présentes ? Une équipe accueillante : Rejoignez notre équipe amicale, ouverte d'esprit et talentueuse, où vos compétences seront valorisées et vos contributions feront une réelle différence. Travail dynamique et stimulant : Vivez des activités quotidiennes intéressantes, stimulantes et diversifiées, en vous gardant engagé et motivé. Investir dans votre croissance : Nous sommes passionnés par le développement de notre personnel, et vous aurez accès à diverses possibilités de formation et de perfectionnement pour améliorer vos compétences et faire progresser votre carrière. La culture Piaget d'encourager Extra-Care, d'encourager la maîtrise et de faire sortir l'extraordinaire dans notre peuple, signifie que nous allons toujours aller plus loin, faisant ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant. Ensemble. Si vous voulez en faire partie, n'hésitez pas à postuler! jobs.description: Reference code: JR128550 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The Swiss HR Team currently has an opening for a 6-month internship in the Learning & Development (L&D) department, where you will support Richemont employees to improve their skills throughout their career. You will be part of a team, based at the HQ in Geneva, that will develop programs while adapting the offers to the best training objectives through virtual sessions and in-person classes. You will be responsible for the management, logistics and evaluation of these trainings. Training Coordination: Coordinate with external vendors to schedule and manage training sessions, both online and at our two designated locations, ensuring seamless execution. "Richemont Toastmasters" Community Management: Animate and cultivate the "Richemont Toastmasters" community, implementing strategies to enhance member engagement and participation. Learning Platform Administration: Manage user access and assignments for Speexx and Coursera licenses, optimizing utilization of these learning platforms. Learning Management System (LMS) Administration: Create, manage, and maintain learning events and sessions within the Cornerstone LMS, including registration management and session closure. Provide support to other services for course historization and creation within the system. Logistics Management: Oversee catering arrangements for training sessions, ensuring timely and high-quality service delivery. Training Session Support: Manage participant registration lists, confirm attendance with vendors, and distribute post-training evaluation forms to gather feedback. Stakeholder Communication: Provide effective support to internal and external stakeholders, maintaining clear and timely communication channels to address inquiries and provide updates. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree in an HR related field, Business, Project management or equivalent Experience in any kind of project management activity is an asset Excellent Microsoft Office skills (Excel & PowerPoint) Self-starter, independent, attention to detail, punctual Adaptable and customer service oriented Ability to perform under pressure Positive and a “can-do” attitude Fluent in both English and French Available for a 6-months internship with starting date 01.08.2026 Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. Codice di riferimento: JR128550 Richemont possiede alcune delle più importanti case di lusso al mondo, con particolare attenzione all'orologeria, agli accessori di lusso e alla gioielleria. Ogni casa rappresenta una tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont cerca di preservare l'eredità e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue case. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che rispettino i valori delle nostre case attraverso un processo di creatività continua. Il team HR svizzero ha attualmente un'apertura per un tirocinio di 6 mesi nel dipartimento di Learning & Development (L&D), in cui supporterai i dipendenti Richemont per migliorare le loro competenze nel corso della loro carriera. Sarai parte di un team, con sede presso la sede di Ginevra, che sviluppa programmi mentre adatta le offerte agli obiettivi di formazione più appropriati attraverso sessioni virtuali e corsi in presenza. Sarai responsabile della gestione, della logistica e della valutazione di questi corsi. Coordinamento della formazione: Coordinare con i fornitori esterni per programmare e gestire le sessioni di formazione, sia online che nei nostri due luoghi designati, garantendo un'esecuzione senza interruzioni. "Richemont Toastmasters" Gestione della comunità: Animare e coltivare la comunità "Richemont Toastmasters", implementando strategie per migliorare l'impegno e la partecipazione dei membri. Amministrazione della piattaforma di apprendimento: Gestire l'accesso degli utenti e le assegnazioni per le licenze Speexx e Coursera, ottimizzando l'utilizzo di queste piattaforme di apprendimento. Amministrazione del sistema di gestione dell'apprendimento (LMS): Creare, gestire e mantenere gli eventi e le sessioni di apprendimento all'interno del Cornerstone LMS, inclusa la gestione della registrazione e la chiusura delle sessioni. Fornire supporto ad altri servizi per la storicizzazione e la creazione dei corsi all'interno del sistema. Gestione della logistica: Sorvegliare gli accordi per il catering per le sessioni di formazione, garantendo la consegna tempestiva e di alta qualità dei servizi. Supporto alle sessioni di formazione: Gestire le liste di registrazione dei partecipanti, confermare la presenza con i fornitori e distribuire i moduli di valutazione post-formazione per raccogliere i feedback. Comunicazione con i stakeholder: Fornire un supporto efficace agli stakeholder interni ed esterni, mantenendo canali di comunicazione chiari e tempestivi per rispondere alle domande e fornire aggiornamenti.
• Per sperimentare il successo con noi:
• Attualmente iscritto a un master in un campo HR, business, project management o equivalente.
• Esperienza in qualsiasi attività di project management è un asset.
• Eccellenti competenze in Microsoft Office (Excel & PowerPoint).
• Autonomo, attento ai dettagli, puntuale.
• Adattabile e orientato al servizio clienti.
• Able to perform under pressure.
• Positivo e con un atteggiamento "puoi farlo".
• Fluente in inglese e francese.
• Disponibile per un tirocinio di 6 mesi con data di inizio 01.08.2026.
• Obbligatorio accordo di tirocinio con la tua scuola/università. Cosa rende il nostro gruppo diverso: Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e competenze umane, nonché nella nostra specifica capacità di coltivare il potenziale inespresso.
• Valutiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà.
• Favoriamo l'empatia, la curiosità, il coraggio, l'umiltà e l'integrità.
• Ci prendiamo cura del mondo in cui viviamo. Il tuo viaggio con noi: Se la tua candidatura viene selezionata, ti contatteremo presto per una chiamata di presentazione. Nel corso del processo di selezione, garantiamo sempre una completa visione e trasparenza, ovvero avrai la possibilità di incontrare le persone che saranno fondamentali per il tuo futuro successo nel ruolo.

Referenzcode: JR128550 Richemont gehört zu den führenden Luxusgüterhäusern der Welt mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Juwelierwaren, hochwertigen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jedes Haus verkörpert eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont strebt danach, die Tradition und Identität jedes seiner Häuser zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir jedoch innovativ und gestalten neue Produkte, die im Einklang mit den Werten unserer Häuser stehen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. Das Schweizer HR-Team hat derzeit eine Stelle für ein 6-monatiges Praktikum im Bereich Learning & Development (L&D) zu besetzen, bei dem Sie Richemont-Mitarbeiter dabei unterstützen, ihre Fähigkeiten im Laufe ihrer Karriere zu verbessern. Sie werden Teil eines Teams sein, das am Hauptsitz in Genf ansässig ist und Programme entwickelt, während es die Angebote an die besten Trainingsziele anpasst, und zwar durch virtuelle Sitzungen und Präsenzveranstaltungen. Sie sind für die Verwaltung, die Logistik und die Bewertung dieser Trainings verantwortlich. Trainingskoordination: Koordinieren Sie mit externen Anbietern, um Trainingsitzungen zu planen und zu verwalten, sowohl online als auch an unseren beiden bezeichneten Standorten, und sorgen Sie für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. "Richemont Toastmasters" Community-Management: Animieren und pflegen Sie die "Richemont Toastmasters"-Community und implementieren Sie Strategien, um die Mitgliedschaft und Teilnahme zu erhöhen. Lernplattform-Administration: Verwalten Sie den Benutzerzugriff und die Zuweisungen für Speexx- und Coursera-Lizenzen und optimieren Sie die Nutzung dieser Lernplattformen. Lernmanagementsystem-Administration (LMS): Erstellen, verwalten und pflegen Sie Lernereignisse und -sitzungen innerhalb des Cornerstone-LMS, einschließlich der Verwaltung der Registrierung und des Sitzungsabschlusses. Stellen Sie Unterstützung für andere Dienste zur Kurshistorisierung und -erstellung innerhalb des Systems bereit. Logistikmanagement: Überwachen Sie die Verpflegungsarrangements für Trainingssitzungen und sorgen Sie für eine zeitgerechte und hochwertige Dienstleistungslieferung. Trainingssitzungsunterstützung: Verwalten Sie die Teilnehmerregistrierungslisten, bestätigen Sie die Anwesenheit bei Anbietern und verteilen Sie die Fragebögen zur Nach-Trainingsevaluation, um Feedback zu sammeln. Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Stellen Sie effektive Unterstützung für interne und externe Stakeholder bereit und sorgen Sie für klare und zeitgerechte Kommunikationskanäle, um Anfragen zu beantworten und Updates zu liefern. Um mit uns erfolgreich zu sein:
• Aktuell eingeschrieben in einem Master-Studiengang im Bereich HR, Business, Project Management oder Ähnlichem.
• Erfahrung in jeder Art von Projektmanagementtätigkeit ist von Vorteil.
• Exzellente Microsoft Office-Fähigkeiten (Excel & PowerPoint).
• Selbstständig, aufmerksam auf Details, pünktlich.
• Anpassungsfähig und kundenorientiert.
• Able to perform under pressure.
• Positiv und mit einer "Kann es machen"-Einstellung.
• Fließend in Englisch und Französisch.
• Verfügbar für ein 6-monatiges Praktikum mit dem Startdatum 01.08.2026.
• Pflichtinternship-Vereinbarung mit Ihrer Schule/Universität. Was unterscheidet unsere Gruppe: Unser wahres Potenzial liegt nicht in unseren Ähnlichkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer spezifischen Fähigkeit, ungenutztes Potenzial zu fördern.

Im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses gewährleisten wir immer vollständige Einblicke und Transparenz, nämlich du wirst die Chance haben, die Menschen kennenzulernen, die für deinen zukünftigen Erfolg in der Rolle entscheidend sein werden.

jobs.description: Reference code: JR128597 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? We are looking for our HR Coordinator to join our Swiss Market team for a 18 months fixed-term contract. The HR Admin specialist will be responsible for the HR Administration for the Swiss Market and Richemont Europe. The HR Coordinator will work closely with the HR Team, the Business and the Payroll & Insurance team. Your main responsibilities will be: Managing all essential HR Administrative processes for the whole employee life cycle (contracts, addendum, work certificate, etc…) Interacting with employees in offices and boutiques from both Maisons & Richemont in Switzerland Ensuring all data are up to date in SAP HR and being the point of contact with the Payroll & Insurance team on relevant topics such as: on and off boarding, internal transfer and payroll Monitoring personnel records & HR procedures (personal details, position, salary, appraisal outcomes, leave records, training and awards) in accordance with compliance, laws and policies Assisting in payroll preparation by providing relevant data to the HR payroll team Providing administrative support to the HR Team on various processes (talent acquisition, performance management, audit, etc…) Looking at digital solutions, seeking at continuous improvement in our ways of working and operational excellence. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR128597 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter Maisons, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, feinen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jede Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jeder seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovationen und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND? Wir suchen unseren HR-Koordinator für einen 18-monatigen befristeten Vertrag. Der HR Admin Spezialist wird für die HR Administration für den Schweizer Markt und Richemont Europe verantwortlich sein. Der HR-Koordinator wird eng mit dem HR-Team, dem Business und dem Payroll & Insurance-Team zusammenarbeiten. 
• Ihre Hauptaufgaben werden sein: Verwaltung aller wesentlichen HR-Verwaltungsprozesse für den gesamten Mitarbeiterlebenszyklus (Verträge, Addendum, Arbeitszertifikat, etc...) Interaktion mit Mitarbeitern in Büros und Boutiquen von Maisons & Richemont in der Schweiz Sicherstellen, dass alle Daten in SAP HR auf dem neuesten Stand sind und Kontakt mit dem Payroll & Insurance-Team zu relevanten Themen wie: On- und Off-Boarding, interne Transfer- und Gehaltsüberwachung Personalakten & HR-Verfahren (persönliche Daten, Position, Gehalt, Bewertungsergebnisse, Urlaubsaufzeichnungen, Schulungen und Auszeichnungen) in Übereinstimmung mit Compliance, Gesetzen und Richtlinien Unterstützung bei der Gehaltsabrechnungsvorbereitung durch Bereitstellung relevanter Daten an das HR-Gehaltsabrechnungsteam Bereitstellung administrativer Unterstützung für das HR-Team zu verschiedenen Prozessen (Talent Acquisition, Performance Management, Audit, etc...) Blick auf digitale Lösungen, auf der Suche nach kontinuierlicher Verbesserung unserer Arbeitsweise und operative Exzellenz. Zentralisierung der internen HR-Kommunikation (HR-Ankündigung, verschiedene Kommunikation usw.) Unterstützung von Finanzprozessen (Kaufaufträge, Rechnungsstellung, Budget) WIE ERFAHREN SIE ERFOLG MIT UNS? Sie besitzen ein Certificate of Gestionnaire RH, Brevet Federal, Bachelor-Abschluss in HR oder gleichwertig Sie haben 3 bis 5 Jahre HR-Verwaltungserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld Workday, SAP HR und MS Office hat kein Geheimnis für Sie Sie verfügen über umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Schweizer Personalpolitik und Arbeitsgesetzgebung Sie haben starke organisatorische und Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten Sie haben starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, sind in der Lage, Multitasking und arbeiten mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern Sie sind detail- und lösungsorientiert, autonom, praxisnah und ein starker Teamplayer Sie sprechen fließend Englisch und Französisch, Deutsch ein starkes Asset Sie fragen sich immer noch, warum Sie sich bewerben sollten? Sie treten einem freundlichen und dynamischen Team bei, mit dem Sie Ihr Wissen und Fachwissen teilen können Entrepreneurship, Vertrauen, Integrität und agiles Lernen sind Teil unseres großartigen Teamgeistes Sie werden mit zahlreichen Stakeholdern in allen Maisons interagieren, Funktionen, die unsere Gruppe anders machen? Unsere wahre Macht liegt nicht in unseren Ähnlichkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer spezifischen Fähigkeit, ungenutztes Potenzial zu fördern. Wir schätzen Freiheit, Kollegialität, Loyalität und Solidarität. - Wir fördern Empathie, Neugier, Mut, Demut und Integrität. - Wir kümmern uns um die Welt, in der wir leben. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR128597 Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux biens de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Nous sommes à la recherche de notre coordinateur RH pour rejoindre notre équipe du marché suisse pour un contrat à durée déterminée de 18 mois. Le spécialiste de l'administration des RH sera responsable de l'administration des RH du marché suisse et de Richemont Europe. Le coordonnateur des RH travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe des RH, l'entreprise et l'équipe de la paie et de l'assurance. Vos principales responsabilités seront : Gérer tous les processus administratifs essentiels des RH pour tout le cycle de vie des employés (contrats, addendum, certificat de travail, etc...) Interagir avec les employés des bureaux et des boutiques de Maisons & Richemont en Suisse S'assurer que toutes les données sont à jour dans SAP HR et qu'elles sont le point de contact avec l'équipe Payroll & Insurance sur des sujets pertinents tels que : pensionnement, transfert interne et états de paie Surveillance des dossiers du personnel et des procédures RH (détails personnels, poste, salaire, résultats de l'évaluation, dossiers de congés, formation et bourses) conformément aux lois et politiques. En regardant les solutions numériques, en cherchant à améliorer continuellement nos méthodes de travail et d'excellence opérationnelle. Centralisation des communications internes des RH (annonce des RH, diverses communications, etc.) Soutien aux processus financiers (commandes d'achat, facturation, budget) COMMENT VOS EXPÉRIENCES SUCCÈS AVEC NOUS? Vous possédez un certificat de gestionnaire RH, Brevet Federal, baccalauréat en RH ou équivalent Vous avez 3 à 5 ans d'expérience administrative RH dans un environnement exigeant Journée de travail, SAP HR et MS Office n'a aucun secret pour vous Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie des politiques suisses RH et de la législation du travail Vous avez de solides compétences organisationnelles et de gestion du temps Vous avez de solides compétences interpersonnelles, êtes en mesure de multitâcher et de travailler avec différents intervenants Vous êtes detail et solution-oriented, autonome, pratique et un joueur d'équipe solide Vous êtes couramment en anglais et en français, allemand un atout fort Vous vous demandez encore pourquoi, vous devriez postuler? Vous rejoindrez une équipe amicale et dynamique avec laquelle vous pourrez partager vos connaissances et votre expertise Entrepreneurship, confiance, intégrité et apprentissage agile font partie de notre grand esprit d'équipe Vous interagirez avec de nombreuses parties prenantes à travers Maisons, Fonctions QU'EST-CE QUE NOTRE GROUPE DIFFÉRENT? Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similarités, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique de favoriser un potentiel inexploité. Nous apprécions la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Oui. Nous favorisons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Oui. Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE JOURNÉE AVEC NOUS Envoyez votre demande en ligne. Si votre profil correspond à notre recherche, nous vous contacterons pour une entrevue. Sinon, vous recevrez un courriel pour vous informer que votre demande n'a pas été retenue. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Emplois similaires Spécialiste de la paie et de l'assurance sociale - IWC Manufacture Save Schaffhausen, Suisse Richemont Coordonnateur des RH F&A Save New York, États-Unis Richemont Spécialiste de la paie et de l'assurance sociale Save Meyrin, Suisse Richemont

Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Rattaché(e) à la Directrice RH, vous serez en charge d’apporter un support à l’équipe RH dans la gestion administrative des tâches suivantes : Gestion des temps Accompagner les collaborateurs et les managers dans la gestion des temps (correction des timbrages, suivi des compteurs, renseignements des différents interlocuteurs) Communication interne Participer à l’organisation de différents événements et de réunions Etablir des supports de communication interne (mailing, écrans, création de supports visuels…) Gérer les affichages sur le site Formation Planifier les sessions de formation Suivre administrativement les formations (inscriptions, réalisation des demandes d’achat, lien avec les fournisseurs, mise à jour du catalogue) Gérer les réservations liées à l’organisation (salle, repas...) Assistanat de l’équipe RH Passer les commandes pour l’équipe et faire les demandes d’achat liées Répondre aux demandes des collaborateurs Apporter un support aux tâches administratives relatives à la gestion du personnel (certificats de travail, attestations, réponse aux candidatures, correspondances diverses) Assurer le suivi et la tenue des dossiers physiques et électroniques des collaborateurs S'impliquer dans les actions sociales (cartes, cadeaux, fleurs, retraite, anniversaires) Vous aurez l’opportunité de collaborer avec les différents interlocuteurs de la fonction RH tout en vous formant sur les outils du marché comme SAP, Workday, Canva, Asana. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS RÉUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Vous êtes étudiant ayant terminé votre 3ème année à l’école de commerce dans une filière avec maturité professionnelle. Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques et de la suite Office Vous êtes une personne organisée, avec le sens du service, une bonne communication et respect de la confidentialité. QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Rejoignez un environnement de travail stimulant où l'héritage de l'horlogerie de luxe rencontre l'innovation. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation approfondie en tout au long de votre stage, des tâches variées et intéressantes, ainsi que d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour atteindre vos objectifs professionnels. Nous sommes convaincus que l'autonomie est un élément clé pour la réussite professionnelle, c'est pourquoi nous offrons un environnement de travail qui vous permettra d'être pleinement responsable dans votre travail. Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature complète sur notre site de carrières. jobs.title: Europe FP&A Controller
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128623 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Europe FP&A controller is responsible for financial planning and analysis of the full Europe region for one or two defined Maison(s) of the Group as well as of the wholesale business in Europe for a defined scope of Maisons. This role involves being a key financial partner for Europe Maison Management and Finance teams to support business operations and decision making. This position is a 6-month fixed-term position starting in July 2026 until end of December 2026. Reporting to Europe FP&A Manager, the position is based in Meyrin, Geneva, within our ‘Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie’. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Europe Maison FP&A The regional controller is responsible for the consolidation, review and challenge of the local forecasts to ensure alignment with HQ and Maison European management guidelines. Reporting: Consolidation of the Europe markets’ financial statements to report to Maison HQ as well as to Maison European Management. Analytical review of actuals vs forecasts, interact with appropriate stakeholders to understand/correct deviations, and ensure business commentary Planning: Consolidate, analyze and challenge figures to ensure Maison forecasts are in line with the Region / Maison Depending on the Maison, present the Annual budget to the Maison Exco along with the Europe Management Europe Wholesale Financial Planning Coordinate the consolidation of the full P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons Adjust budget figures based on quarterly reviews with the appropriate stakeholders Communicate forecasts and gap analysis to the Maisons HQ Europe Wholesale Monthly Closing & Reporting Activities Perform analytical reviews on the P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons and report results with comments to Maisons’ HQ Develop and maintain financial reporting to proactively support Maisons’ decision-making processes Support the Management Reporting process (upload and reconcile actual monthly results into the system for consolidation) Run various checks and corrections to ensure accurate closing in line with IFRS Operations Act as a true business partner and strengthen the relationship with Maisons Ensure continuous improvement of business processes to gain efficiency in the organization Support Richemont Europe Management in various ad-hoc requests Participate actively in controlling ad-hoc projects (e.g. system automation, community management, closing process improvements, digitalization, cash-flow guidance, etc.) HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are able to thrive in a complex fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, balance multiple priorities while still contribute thoughtful and high-quality work. You are result oriented with appetite for efficiency through reports automation. You are a strong team player with the ability to communicate and build relationships with various internal partners including Richemont & Maisons Regional Excos. You work well in group problem-solving situations and generate creative solutions. You want to learn quickly with a strong analytic & critical mind-set. You want to evolve in an international and diverse environment, with strong exposure to Top Management. You are capable of being self-motivated and autonomous. Then, you must be the right talent to join our regional team as Europe FP&A Controller. Masters degree in Finance or Business Administration or equivalent 5 years minimum, of confirmed experience in Finance (FP&A, controlling or audit) Experience in Luxury industry a plus Fluent in English, any additional language is a plus You have advanced skills in Excel, you are able to execute analysis in financial and analytical tools (knowledge of SAP and Business Warehouse) Automated and digital skills are a plus WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call with the Talent Acquisition Partner. 2. The next step from there would be a panel of interviews, including with the Hiring Manager and the HR Manager. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Brand Controller Save Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China Richemont FP&A Controller Save Istanbul, Türkiye Richemont FP&A Intern Save Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR128623 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. CONTESTO Il controller Europe FP&A è responsabile per la pianificazione finanziaria e l'analisi della regione dell'intera Europa per una o due Maison(s) del Gruppo e del business all'ingrosso in Europa per un ambito definito di Maisons. Questo ruolo implica essere un partner finanziario chiave per i team Europe Maison Management e Finance per supportare le operazioni aziendali e il processo decisionale. Questa posizione è una posizione fissa di 6 mesi a partire dal luglio 2026 fino alla fine del dicembre 2026. Segnalandosi a Europe FP&A Manager, la posizione è basata a Meyrin, Ginevra, all’interno della nostra “Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie”. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Europa Maison FP&A Il controllore regionale è responsabile per il consolidamento, la revisione e la sfida delle previsioni locali per garantire l'allineamento con gli orientamenti di gestione HQ e Maison Europe. Reporting: Consolidamento del bilancio dei mercati europei per riferire alla Maison HQ e alla Maison European Management. Analisi analitica dei risultati delle valutazioni reali e delle previsioni, interagire con gli stakeholder appropriati per comprendere/correggere le deviazioni, e garantire il commento aziendale Pianificazione: Consolidare, analizzare e sfidare i dati per garantire che le previsioni della Maison siano in linea con la Regione / Maison A seconda della Maison, presentare il bilancio annuale alla Maison Exco insieme alla European Management Europe Wholesale Financial Planning Coordinate il consolidamento dei risultati completi di P&L e Cash Flow per un determinato ambito di bilancio Eseguire vari controlli e correzioni per garantire una chiusura accurata in linea con IFRS Operations Act come un vero partner commerciale e rafforzare il rapporto con Maisons Assicurare un miglioramento continuo dei processi aziendali per ottenere efficienza nell'organizzazione Support Richemont Europe Management in varie richieste ad-hoc Partecipare attivamente al controllo di progetti ad-hoc (ad esempio automazione del sistema, gestione della comunità, miglioramenti dei processi di chiusura, digitalizzazione, orientamento cash-flow, ecc.) Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Siete in grado di prosperare in un ambiente complesso e veloce sotto scadenze strette, bilanciare più priorità, mentre ancora contribuiscono lavoro premuroso e di alta qualità. Siete orientati al risultato con l'appetito per l'efficienza attraverso l'automazione dei rapporti. Sei un giocatore di squadra forte con la capacità di comunicare e costruire relazioni con vari partner interni tra cui Richemont & Maisons Regional Excos. Si lavora bene in situazioni di problem solving di gruppo e generare soluzioni creative. Si desidera imparare rapidamente con un forte analitico e mentale critica. Si desidera evolvere in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato, con una forte esposizione a Top Management. Siete capaci di essere automotivati e autonomi. Allora, devi essere il talento giusto per unirti al nostro team regionale come controller europeo FP&A. Laurea magistrale in Finanza o Business Administration o equivalente minimo 5 anni, di esperienza confermata in Finanza (FP&A, controllo o audit) Esperienza nel settore del lusso un plus Fluent in inglese, qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un plus Hai competenze avanzate in Excel, sei in grado di eseguire analisi in strumenti finanziari e analitici (conoscenza di SAP e Business Warehouse) Le competenze automatizzate e digitali sono un plus COSA MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. - No. Adottiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità. - No. Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. Il tuo matrimonio con noi 1. Se la tua applicazione è selezionata, ti raggiungiamo al più presto per una chiamata informale introduttiva con il Talent Acquisition Partner. 2. Il passo successivo da là sarebbe un pannello di interviste, tra cui con il responsabile dell'assunzione e il responsabile delle risorse umane. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Brand Controller Save Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China Richemont FP&A Controller Save Istanbul, Türkiye Richemont FP&A Intern Save Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Richemont

Jede Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jeder seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovationen und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. KONTEXT Der Europe FP&A Controller ist verantwortlich für die Finanzplanung und Analyse der gesamten Region Europa für ein oder zwei definierte Maison(s) der Gruppe sowie des Großhandelsgeschäfts in Europa für einen definierten Umfang von Maisons. Diese Rolle besteht darin, ein wichtiger Finanzpartner für die Management- und Finanzteams von Europe Maison zu sein, um den Geschäftsbetrieb und die Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen. Diese Position ist eine 6-monatige befristete Position, die im Juli 2026 bis Ende Dezember 2026 beginnt. Die Stelle, die an den Europe FP&A Manager berichtet, hat ihren Sitz in Meyrin, Genf, in unserem „Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie. WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND? Europa Maison FP&A Der regionale Controller ist für die Konsolidierung, Überprüfung und Herausforderung der lokalen Prognosen verantwortlich, um die Angleichung an die HQ und die europäischen Managementrichtlinien von Maison sicherzustellen. descriptionByLocale.fr: Reference code: JR128623 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Europe FP&A controller is responsible for financial planning and analysis of the full Europe region for one or two defined Maison(s) of the Group as well as of the wholesale business in Europe for a defined scope of Maisons. This role involves being a key financial partner for Europe Maison Management and Finance teams to support business operations and decision making. This position is a 6-month fixed-term position starting in July 2026 until end of December 2026. Reporting to Europe FP&A Manager, the position is based in Meyrin, Geneva, within our ‘Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie’. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Europe Maison FP&A The regional controller is responsible for the consolidation, review and challenge of the local forecasts to ensure alignment with HQ and Maison European management guidelines. Reporting: Consolidation of the Europe markets’ financial statements to report to Maison HQ as well as to Maison European Management. Analytical review of actuals vs forecasts, interact with appropriate stakeholders to understand/correct deviations, and ensure business commentary Planning: Consolidate, analyze and challenge figures to ensure Maison forecasts are in line with the Region / Maison Depending on the Maison, present the Annual budget to the Maison Exco along with the Europe Management Europe Wholesale Financial Planning Coordinate the consolidation of the full P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons Adjust budget figures based on quarterly reviews with the appropriate stakeholders Communicate forecasts and gap analysis to the Maisons HQ Europe Wholesale Monthly Closing & Reporting Activities Perform analytical reviews on the P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons and report results with comments to Maisons’ HQ Develop and maintain financial reporting to proactively support Maisons’ decision-making processes Support the Management Reporting process (upload and reconcile actual monthly results into the system for consolidation) Run various checks and corrections to ensure accurate closing in line with IFRS Operations Act as a true business partner and strengthen the relationship with Maisons Ensure continuous improvement of business processes to gain efficiency in the organization Support Richemont Europe Management in various ad-hoc requests Participate actively in controlling ad-hoc projects (e.g. system automation, community management, closing process improvements, digitalization, cash-flow guidance, etc.) HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are able to thrive in a complex fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, balance multiple priorities while still contribute thoughtful and high-quality work. You are result oriented with appetite for efficiency through reports automation. You are a strong team player with the ability to communicate and build relationships with various internal partners including Richemont & Maisons Regional Excos. You work well in group problem-solving situations and generate creative solutions. You want to learn quickly with a strong analytic & critical mind-set. You want to evolve in an international and diverse environment, with strong exposure to Top Management. You are capable of being self-motivated and autonomous. Then, you must be the right talent to join our regional team as Europe FP&A Controller. Masters degree in Finance or Business Administration or equivalent 5 years minimum, of confirmed experience in Finance (FP&A, controlling or audit) Experience in Luxury industry a plus Fluent in English, any additional language is a plus You have advanced skills in Excel, you are able to execute analysis in financial and analytical tools (knowledge of SAP and Business Warehouse) Automated and digital skills are a plus WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. jobs.description: Reference code: JR128696 FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Join one of the most respected Maisons in fine watchmaking where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE We are seeking a High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager who will be responsible for generating qualitative high value sales (exceptional/Les Cabinotiers timepieces) by developing his own VIC/VVIC client portfolio, cultivating strong relationships and leveraging the Maison hospitality platform, whilst also recruiting new clients/UHNWI. Collaboratively with international markets, this role will develop and treat VIC/VVIC/UHNWI visiting our Manufacture in Geneva, and other regional locations. Based in our Manufacture in Plan-les-Ouates and reporting to High Watchmaking Client Director, this role will work cross functionally (HQ and Markets) at Europe level. The High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager plays a key and strategic role in growing our Maison reputation and desirability within the region. PLAYING YOUR PART Drive Client strategy and support Clients' development You will drive qualitative high value/Les Cabinotiers sales, in line with the Maison’s strategy and scarcity guidelines You will work off-site to grow your clients' network and to recruit new clients You will refer prospects to Boutiques in their home Market and support their Client journey You will work hand in hand with Boutiques to ensure the highest level of service before, during and after the sale when needed. You will manage VIC/VVIC clients' complaints and offer solutions Collaboratively with European/International markets, you will leverage Maison opportunities including the Hospitality platform, deliver unique and tailor-made Client experience You will work closely and support Boutique Managers within the Europe/International region, on coaching and developing their Sales team to grow the VIC/VVIC client base Define yearly action plans to recruit new Clients and contribute to the development of existing ones You will develop your own VIC/VVIC client portfolio, propose and align action plans to increase loyalty and develop high value/Les Cabinotiers sales You will assess market opportunities and potential to target and acquire new Clients; pro-actively suggest new development opportunities (event/places/intermediaries) to recruit new VIC/VVIC Clients You will evaluate existing Client’s journey and development within the markets/within the region, in particular sleeping VIC/VVIC clients, and contribute to (re-)activate them Support HQ Hospitality team You will work hand in hand with Markets and Hospitality Clients Manager to support Hospitality plans for their VIC/VVIC clients coming to Geneva You will host Clients in Switzerland out of the Manufacture, during diners, events, fairs or dedicated activations, and host them in the Manufacture together with Hospitality Clients Manager You will share post Clients’ activities/events analyses and reports with markets for local follow-up You will participate in local, regional and international Maison Events, acting as our Ambassador You will participate and be proactive in the enrichment of the Client experience offer, Hospitality services and overall Client treatment You will pass on knowledge to other Client Relationship Managers/Grand Vendeurs/Sales teams You will contribute to the administration of the Manufacture Salon-Boutique in daily operations (invoicing, shipping, after sales service, inventory, stock management in full compliance with the Maison and Richemont guidelines) together with the Hospitality Clients Manager WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require A solid 10+ years’ experience in Sales with proven records in managing VIC/VVIC Clients acquisition, engagement through strong partnerships and retention Self-entrepreneur and a self-motivated person, agile, broad-scanner, critical thinker, with ability to innovate, drive change and work autonomously Excellent knowledge of luxury Market, including watchmaking and jewellery brands, luxury fashion and trends and latest news in town and in the world Elegance, Passion, Generosity, Audacity, and Quest for Excellence, with excellent presentation skills and a high sense of client privacy & Maison’s confidentiality Proactivity with a “get-it-done” results-driven attitude, autonomy and ability to work independently to achieve the goals whilst being a strong team player for transverse activation - with a positive and resilient attitude Flexibility towards international travels Fluency in French and English, any other language a plus Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR128696 Dans l'univers de la Maison, nos collaborurs de tous orizzonti partagent avec passion un but commun : la quête permanente de l'excellence portée par les compétences et l'engagement eccezioninels des femmes et des hommes qui travaillent dans notre Manufacture. Maison de conosciurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamais cessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Siate uno dei non molti per il pensiero che vede l'ESCELLENZA Unisciti a una delle Maison più rispettate nell'orologeria dove l'eccellenza è sia una data che una ricerca senza fine. Gioca la tua parte nella guida del nostro successo collettivo. Il tuo!
• Stiamo cercando un High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager che sarà responsabile della generazione di vendite ad alto valore qualitativo (exceptional/Les Cabinotiers timepieces) sviluppando il proprio portafoglio clienti VIC/VVIC, coltivando forti relazioni e sfruttando la piattaforma di ospitalità della Maison, reclutando anche nuovi clienti/UHNWI. Collaborativamente con i mercati internazionali, questo ruolo svilupperà e tratterà VIC/VVIC/UHNWI visitando la nostra Manifattura a Ginevra, e altre sedi regionali. Sulla base della nostra Manifattura in Plan-les-Ouates e della relazione al Direttore clienti di alta qualità dell'orologeria, questo ruolo funzionerà in modo funzionale (HQ e Markets) a livello europeo. L'High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager svolge un ruolo chiave e strategico nella crescita della nostra reputazione e della disabilità della Maison all'interno della regione. Pianificare la strategia del cliente e sostenere lo sviluppo dei clienti Guiderete le vendite qualitative di alta qualità/Les Cabinotiers, in linea con la strategia della Maison e le linee guida di scarsità Potrai lavorare fuori sede per crescere la rete dei tuoi clienti e per reclutare nuovi clienti Riferirete le prospettive di Boutique nel loro mercato domestico e sostenere il loro viaggio cliente Potrai lavorare di pari passo con Boutique per garantire il più alto livello di servizio prima, durante e dopo la vendita quando necessario. Gestirete i reclami dei clienti VIC/VVIC e offrirete soluzioni In collaborazione con i mercati europei / internazionali, potrete sfruttare le opportunità di Maison tra cui la piattaforma Hospitality, fornire un'esperienza clienti unica e su misura Si lavorerà a stretto contatto e supporterà Boutique Manager all'interno della regione Europa / Internazionale, su coaching e sviluppo del loro team di vendita per crescere la base clienti VIC / VVIC Definire piani di azione annuali per reclutare nuovi clienti e contribuire allo sviluppo di quelli esistenti Svilupperai il tuo portafoglio clienti VIC/VVIC, proporrai e allineerai i piani d'azione per aumentare la lealtà e sviluppare un alto valore/Les Cabinotiers sales Valuterai le opportunità di mercato e il potenziale per indirizzare e acquisire nuovi Clienti; pro-attivamente suggerisci nuove opportunità di sviluppo (event/places/intermediaries) per reclutare nuovi clienti VIC/VVIC Valuterai il viaggio e lo sviluppo dei clienti esistenti all’interno dei mercati/all’interno della regione, in particolare i clienti VIC/VVIC che dormono, e contribuiranno (ri-)attivarli Support HQ Hospitality team Si lavorerà di pari passo con Markets and Hospitality Clients Manager per sostenere i piani di ospitalità per i loro clienti VIC/VVIC che verranno a Ginevra. Condividerai attività/eventi dei Clienti analisi e rapporti con i mercati per il follow-up locale Parteciperai a eventi di Maison locali, regionali e internazionali, in qualità di nostro Ambasciatore parteciperai e sarai proattivo nell'arricchimento dell'offerta di esperienza del cliente, dei servizi di accoglienza e del trattamento generale del cliente Passerai la conoscenza ad altri gestori di relazioni cliente/Grand Vendeurs/Sales team Contribuirai all'amministrazione del Salone-Boutique della Manifattura nelle operazioni quotidiane (fattura, spedizione, servizio post-vendita, inventario, gestione delle scorte nel pieno rispetto delle linee guida Maison e Richemont) insieme al Gestore Clienti dell'OspitalitÃ CHE COSA MAKE TU SUCCESSFUL? Il successo in questo ruolo richiederà un solido 10+ anni di esperienza in vendite con record comprovati nella gestione di VIC/VVIC Clients acquisizione, l'impegno attraverso partnership forti e la ritenzione Self-entrepreneur e una persona auto-motivated, agile, broad-scanner, pensatore critico, con la capacità di innovare, guidare il cambiamento e lavorare autonomamente Eccellente conoscenza del mercato di lusso, tra cui l'orologeria e marchi di gioielli, tendenze di moda e di lusso e di moda e di moda e le ultime notizie Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, gestiamo una rete globale di vendita al dettaglio di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità globale di orologiai, artigiani e professionisti dedicati condividono una comune devozione al nostro patrimonio eccezionale e alla passione per la sciabola di un futuro ancora più luminoso. Se questo accende la vostra immaginazione, accogliamo la vostra applicazione. Gestore clienti di ospitalità di lavori simili Salva Plan-Les-Ouates, Svizzera Vacheron Constantin HEAD di MARKETING SPECIALTIES & HIGH-END OFFER Salva Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Vacheron Constantin Private Client Manager, SEA Save Singapore, Singapore Vacheron Constantin

descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR128696 Dans l'univers de la Maison, nos workingurs de tous horizons partagent avec passion un but commun : la quête permanente de l'excellence portée par les compétences et l'engagement Exceptnels des femmes et des hommes qui travaillent dans notre Manufacture. Maison de connaisseurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamais cessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Seien Sie einer von nicht vielen FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Begleiten Sie eines der angesehensten Maisons in der feinen Uhrmacherei, wo Exzellenz sowohl eine gegebene als auch eine nie endende Quest ist. Spielen Sie Ihren Teil an unserem kollektiven Erfolg. IHRE ROLLE Wir suchen einen High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager, der für die Erzeugung qualitativ hochwertiger Verkäufe (außergewöhnlich/Les Cabinotiers Zeitmesser) verantwortlich ist, indem er sein eigenes VIC/VVIC-Client-Portfolio entwickelt, starke Beziehungen kultiviert und die Maison Hospitality-Plattform nutzt und gleichzeitig neue Kunden/UHNWI rekrutiert. In Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Märkten wird diese Rolle die VIC/VVIC/UHNWI, die unsere Manufaktur in Genf besucht, und andere regionale Standorte entwickeln und behandeln. Mit unserer Fertigung in Plan-les-Ouates und der Berichterstattung an High Watchmaking Client Director wird diese Rolle funktionell (HQ und Märkte) auf europäischer Ebene arbeiten. Der High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager spielt eine wichtige und strategische Rolle bei der Steigerung unserer Maison Reputation und Verzweiflung in der Region. IHRE PART Drive Client Strategie und Unterstützung der Entwicklung von Clients Sie werden qualitativ hohe Werte/Les Cabinotiers-Verkäufe im Einklang mit der Strategie und den Knappheitsrichtlinien von Maison antreiben Sie werden außerhalb der Website arbeiten, um das Netzwerk Ihrer Kunden zu erweitern und neue Kunden einzustellen Sie verweisen auf Boutiquen in ihrem Heimatmarkt und unterstützen ihre Customer Journey Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit Boutiquen, um das höchste Niveau der Dienstleistung vor, während und nach dem Verkauf bei Bedarf zu gewährleisten. Sie verwalten die Beschwerden der VIC/VVIC-Kunden und bieten Lösungen Zusammenarbeit mit europäischen/Internationalen Märkten, Sie nutzen Maison-Möglichkeiten einschließlich der Hospitality-Plattform, liefern einzigartige und maßgeschneiderte Kundenerfahrung Sie werden eng zusammenarbeiten und unterstützen Boutique-Manager in der Region Europa/International, Coaching und Entwicklung ihres Vertriebsteams, um die VIC/VVIC-C-Client-Basis zu wachsen. Sie entwickeln Ihr eigenes VIC/VVIC-Client-Portfolio, schlagen und richten Aktionspläne an, um die Loyalität zu erhöhen und einen hohen Wert/Les Cabinotiers-Vertrieb zu entwickeln Sie werden Marktchancen und Potenziale bewerten, um neue Kunden anzusprechen und zu erwerben; proaktiv schlagen neue Entwicklungschancen (Ereignisse/Stellen/Zwischengänge) vor, um neue VIC/VVIC-Clients einzustellen Sie bewerten die Reise und Entwicklung des bestehenden Kunden in den Märkten/innerhalb der Region, insbesondere schlafende VIC/VVIC-Kunden, und tragen dazu bei, sie zu unterstützen HQ Hospitality Team Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit Markets und Hospitality Clients Manager, um Hospitality Pläne für ihre VIC/VVIC-Kunden zu unterstützen, die nach Genf kommen. Sie werden post Kunden Aktivitäten / Veranstaltungen Analysen und Berichte mit Märkten für lokale Follow-up teilen Sie werden an lokalen, regionalen und internationalen Maison Events teilnehmen, fungieren als unser Botschafter Sie werden teilnehmen und aktiv an der Anreicherung des Kunden-Erfahrungsangebots, Hospitality-Services und Gesamt-Client-Behandlung Sie werden Wissen an andere Client-Beziehungsmanager/Grand Vendeurs/Sales-Teams weitergeben Sie werden zur Verwaltung der Herstellung Salon-Boutique in den täglichen Betrieben beitragen (Rechnung, Versand, nach Verkaufsservice, Inventar, Lagerverwaltung in voller Übereinstimmung mit den Maison und Richemont Richtlinien) zusammen mit dem Hospitality Clients Manager WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Erfolg in dieser Rolle erfordert eine solide 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Vertrieb mit bewährten Aufzeichnungen in der Verwaltung VIC / VVIC Clients Akquisition, Engagement durch starke Partnerschaften und Retention Self-entrepreneur und eine selbst motivierte Person, agile, breit-Scanner, kritische Denker, mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauliche, Laufwerksänderung und Arbeit autonom. Mit Sitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreiben wir ein weltweites Einzelhandelsnetz von fast 200 Verkaufsstellen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen Weltgemeinschaft von Uhrmachern, Kunsthandwerkern und engagierten Profis teilt eine gemeinsame Hingabe zu unserem außergewöhnlichen Erbe und einer Leidenschaft, eine noch hellere Zukunft zu entdecken. Wenn dies Ihre Fantasie feuert, begrüßen wir Ihre Anwendung. Maison de connaisseurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamaiscessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Soyez l'un des rares à découvrir l'excellence Joignez-vous à l'une des maisons les plus respectées de l'horlogerie où l'excellence est à la fois une quête donnée et une quête sans fin. Jouez votre rôle dans la conduite de notre succès collectif. Votre rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de relations client High Watchmaking qui sera responsable de générer des ventes qualitatives de haute valeur (exceptionnelles/Les Cabinotiers) en développant son propre portefeuille de clients VIC/VVIC, en cultivant de solides relations et en tirant parti de la plateforme hôtelière Maison, tout en recrutant de nouveaux clients/UHNWI. En collaboration avec les marchés internationaux, ce rôle développera et traitera VIC/VVIC/UHNWI en visitant notre Manufacture à Genève et d'autres sites régionaux. Basé dans notre Manufacture in Plan-les-Ouates et relevant du Directeur Client de Haute Horlogerie, ce rôle fonctionnera de manière transversale (AC et Marchés) au niveau européen. Le responsable de la relation client High Watchmaking joue un rôle clé et stratégique dans l'amélioration de la réputation et de l'opportunité de notre Maison dans la région. suggérerez pro-activement de nouvelles possibilités de développement (événements/endroits/intermédiaires) pour recruter de nouveaux clients VIC/VIC Vous évaluerez le parcours et le développement des clients existants dans les marchés/dans la région, en particulier les clients de VIC/VVIC endormis, et contribuerez à (ré)activer les clients Support HQ Equipe d'accueil Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec Markets and Hospitality Clients Manager pour soutenir les plans d'accueil de leurs clients VIC/VVIC venant à Genève Vous accueillerez des clients en Suisse hors de la Manufacture, lors de dîners, événements, foires ou activations dédiées, et les accueillirez dans la Manufacture en collaboration avec Hospitality Clients Manager Vous partagerez les analyses et les rapports d'activités/événements des clients avec les marchés pour le suivi local Vous participerez à des événements Maison locaux, régionaux et internationaux, agissant en tant qu'ambassadeur.Vous participerez et serez proactif dans l'enrichissement de l'offre d'expérience client, des services d'accueil et du traitement global des clients.Vous transmettrez vos connaissances à d'autres gestionnaires de relations client/grands Vendeurs/équipes de ventes. Vous contribuerez à l'administration de la Manufacture Salon-Boutique dans les opérations quotidiennes (facturation, expédition, service après-vente, inventaire, gestion des stocks en pleine conformité avec les directives Maison et Richemont) en collaboration avec le gestionnaire des clients d'accueil. Basé à Genève, en Suisse, nous exploitons un réseau mondial de détail de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté mondiale exceptionnelle d'horlogers, d'artisans et de professionnels dévoués partagent une dévotion commune à notre patrimoine exceptionnel et une passion pour faire briller un avenir encore plus brillant. Si cela déclenche votre imagination, nous accueillons votre application.
