descriptionByLocale.fr: Reference code: JR129049 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de notre Manufacture Joaillère située au Locle, notre Département des Ressources Humaines joue un rôle stratégique dans l'accompagnement et le développement de nos talents. Dans un contexte de transformation et d'amélioration continue, nous recherchons pour un CDM de 12 mois un/e Chargé/e de Projet RH dynamique et engagé/e pour renforcer nos équipes. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. A travers son histoire, Cartier s'est démarqué du fait de l'engagement de femmes et d'hommes singuliers. A ce titre, notre Maison offre à toutes et tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Mission Rattaché/e au département des Ressources Humaines, votre mission principale sera de contribuer activement au pilotage et à la coordination de projets clés visant à optimiser nos processus RH et à enrichir l'expérience de nos collaborateurs. Vous serez un acteur central de notre plan de transformation RH, en particulier sur les initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle et d'amélioration continue de l'environnement de travail au sein de la manufacture. Vos Responsabilités Clés : Participer à la définition, la structuration et la validation des cadrages de projets (objectifs, périmètre, livrables, ressources, planning) en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes. Coordonner les différentes phases de déploiement des projets, de la conception à la mise en œuvre, en assurant le respect des délais et des budgets. Mettre en place et animer les instances de suivi de projet, produire des reportings réguliers et clairs à destination de la Direction RH et des comités de pilotage. Identifier les risques et les opportunités, proposer des plans d'action et des solutions innovantes pour garantir le succès des projets. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodologies de gestion de projet au sein du département RH. QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Titulaire d'un diplôme supérieur (Bac+4/5) en Ressources Humaines, Gestion de Projet, ou équivalent, vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience en gestion de projet RH acquise dans un environnement industriel ou de manufacture. Cette expérience vous a permis de développer une solide connaissance des enjeux d'excellence opérationnelle et d'expérience collaborateur. Vous maîtrisez les méthodologies de gestion de projet et possédez une excellente connaissance des processus RH. Vous êtes également à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques (Pack Office, notamment Excel et PowerPoint). Doté/e d'un sens aigu de l'organisation, de rigueur et d'autonomie, vous faites preuve d'excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale, ainsi que d'un sens de la diplomatie. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à fédérer différents acteurs, combinée à votre proactivité, votre force de proposition et votre orientation résultats, sont des atouts essentiels. Enfin, votre esprit d'équipe et votre aisance relationnelle vous permettront de vous intégrer harmonieusement et de collaborer efficacement. VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Notre équipe RH se tient à votre écoute, selon votre souhait et vos besoins, tout au long de votre expérience au sein de notre Maison. Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez l’un de nos Recruteurs, un membre de notre équipe RH, le/la Responsable du poste et passerez des cas d’étude ou d’évaluation en fonction des besoins du poste. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129144 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. We would like to talk to you about the opportunity to join our Maison for an internship as International Employer Branding Intern (6 months). As International Employer Branding Intern, you will have the opportunity to work with the Employer Branding and Academic Relations team in rolling out the new EVP (Employee Value Proposition) on all external channels, ensuring a consistent and compelling employer brand presence externally. This internship will offer you exposure to cross-functionally with HR (particularly Talent and HR Communications), Marketing Communications, and Digital teams to create engaging content and ensure a consistent and compelling employer brand presence for external and potential candidates. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Employee Value Proposition (EVP) roll-out Infuse the new EVP in all our external channels, updating texts and assets, and exploring new formats to evoke the EVP Content Creation Create engaging content (text, images, video) showcasing Cartier's new EVP (culture, values, and employee experiences). Develop employee stories and testimonials. Ensure consistent branding and messaging across all employer branding materials. Follow the competition through EB benchmarking analysis. Identify effective and proficient agency partners for videography and post production releases. Digital Presence Maintain and update Cartier's careers website to ensure optimal performance and user experience. Monitor and manage Cartier's employer brand reputation across external channels. Follow the KPIs and performance analytics. Assist in crisis management following a clear governance and escalation process a when technical issue arises on any of our external channels and platforms. Explore new channels and propose content based on channel consumption. Social Media Engagement Execute Cartier's employer branding social media strategy across platforms such as LinkedIn and Glassdoor. Manage social media channels to attract and engage potential candidates. Monitor social media trends and provide insights to the team. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & PROFILE: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Marketing, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field. Strong understanding of social media and digital marketing. Excellent writing, editing, and presentation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Experience with video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro) is a plus. Experience with graphic design software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Canva) is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French is a plus. WHAT DO WE OFFER We create a positive environment and highlight your personal and team performances. We’re fully transparent and share with you: Maison strategies, key information, needs of others Corporate Departments. We constantly educate you with: Cartier’s savoir-faire, competitive landscape, industry news, client experience best practices. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129144 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. Vorremmo parlarvi dell'opportunità di unirsi alla nostra Maison per uno stage come International Employer Branding Intern (6 mesi). In qualità di International Employer Branding Intern, avrete la possibilità di lavorare con il team di Employer Branding and Academic Relations per lanciare il nuovo EVP (Employee Value Proposition) su tutti i canali esterni, garantendo una presenza costante e avvincente del marchio datore di lavoro esternamente. Questo tirocinio vi offrirà l'esposizione a cross-functionally con HR (in particolare Talent e HR Communications), Marketing Communications e Digital team per creare contenuti coinvolgenti e garantire una presenza costante e convincente del marchio datore di lavoro per candidati esterni e potenziali. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Employee Value Proposition (EVP) roll-out Infonda il nuovo EVP in tutti i nostri canali esterni, aggiorna testi e beni, e esplora nuovi formati per evocare il contenuto EVP Content Creation Crea contenuti coinvolgenti (testo, immagini, video) che mostrano il nuovo EVP di Cartier (cultura, valori e esperienze dei dipendenti). Sviluppare storie e testimonianze dei dipendenti. Assicurare un marchio coerente e messaggistica su tutti i materiali di marca del datore di lavoro. Seguire la concorrenza attraverso analisi di benchmarking EB. Identificare partner di agenzia efficaci e competenti per la videografia e la post-produzione. Mantenere e aggiornare il sito di carriera di Cartier per garantire prestazioni ottimali e l'esperienza utente. Monitorare e gestire la reputazione del marchio datore di lavoro di Cartier attraverso i canali esterni. Seguire i KPI e le analisi delle prestazioni. Assistere nella gestione delle crisi a seguito di un chiaro processo di governance e di escalation un momento in cui il problema tecnico sorge su uno dei nostri canali e piattaforme esterne. Esplora nuovi canali e proponi contenuti basati sul consumo di canali. Social Media Engagement Execute datore di lavoro Cartier branding strategia di social media attraverso piattaforme come LinkedIn e Glassdoor. Gestire canali di social media per attirare e coinvolgere potenziali candidati. Monitorare le tendenze dei social media e fornire informazioni al team. ESPERIENZA REQUIRED & PROFILE: Attualmente iscritta in un corso di laurea o di laurea magistrale in Marketing, Comunicazioni, Risorse Umane, o in un campo relativo. Forte comprensione dei social media e del marketing digitale. Eccellente capacità di scrittura, editing e presentazione. Proficienza in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). L'esperienza con il software di editing video (ad esempio, Adobe Premiere Pro) è un vantaggio. L'esperienza con software di progettazione grafica (ad esempio, Adobe Photoshop, Canva) è un vantaggio. Il francese è un plus. Che cosa discutiamo Creiamo un ambiente positivo ed evidenziamo le prestazioni personali e di squadra. Siamo completamente trasparenti e condividiamo con voi: strategie di Maison, informazioni chiave, esigenze di altri dipartimenti aziendali. Vi istruiamo costantemente con: il savoir-faire di Cartier, il paesaggio competitivo, le notizie del settore, le migliori pratiche di esperienza del cliente. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR129144 L'histoire de Cartier est fondée sur la curiosité et la passion. Depuis plus de 170 ans, nous avons adopté un esprit audacieux et pionnier qui continue d'inspirer nos équipes de tous les Métiers, de nos boutiques à nos ateliers et bureaux corporatifs. Nos 10 000 collègues de plus de 105 nationalités sont unis par un esprit indépendant partagé et un engagement en faveur de l'excellence, s'efforçant d'enrichir continuellement notre patrimoine de Maison en repoussant les frontières de la créativité et de l'innovation. Nous aimerions vous parler de l'occasion de nous joindre à notre Maison pour un stage en tant que stagiaire international de marque (6 mois). En tant que stagiaire de marque internationale de l'employeur, vous aurez l'occasion de travailler avec l'équipe de marque de l'employeur et des relations académiques à la mise en oeuvre de la nouvelle proposition de valeur de l'employeur sur tous les canaux externes, en assurant une présence cohérente et convaincante de la marque de l'employeur à l'extérieur. Ce stage vous permettra de vous familiariser avec les RH (en particulier Talent et RH Communications), les Communications marketing et les équipes numériques afin de créer du contenu attrayant et d'assurer une présence cohérente et convaincante de la marque de l'employeur pour les candidats externes et potentiels. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Déploiement de la proposition de valeur de l'employé(e) Insuffler le nouveau VPE dans tous nos canaux externes, mettre à jour les textes et les actifs, et explorer de nouveaux formats pour évoquer le contenu du VPE Création Créer du contenu engageant (texte, images, vidéo) montrant le nouveau VPE de Cartier (culture, valeurs et expériences des employés). Élaborer des histoires et des témoignages d'employés. Assurer l'uniformité de l'image de marque et de la messagerie dans tous les documents de marque de l'employeur. Suivre le concours par l'analyse comparative EB. Identifier des partenaires efficaces et compétents pour la vidéographie et les sorties après production. Présence numérique Maintenir et mettre à jour le site Web des carrières de Cartier pour assurer une performance et une expérience utilisateur optimales. Surveiller et gérer la réputation de l'employeur de Cartier à travers les canaux externes. Suivez les KPI et l'analyse des performances. Aider à la gestion des crises à la suite d'un processus clair de gouvernance et d'escalade, lorsque des problèmes techniques se posent sur l'un de nos canaux et plateformes externes. Explorer de nouveaux canaux et proposer des contenus basés sur la consommation de canaux. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129201 Supply Chain Engineer Plan-les-Ouates Permanent FOR THOSE WHO WELCOME CONNECTION Join a highly connected community where individual expertise and shared experience combine across disciplines to spark fresh ideas and keep us moving forwards. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE Playing an integral part of the Central Supply Chain Team, the Supply Chain Engineer is a key role responsible for optimising and driving efficient Supply Chain operations across the organisation, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives. This position requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Finance, Development, Commercial and Production Planning to develop, analyse, enhance and execute effective supply plans. The Supply Chain Engineer plays a critical role with strategic initiatives in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), new product introductions, ensuring seamless product availability, minimising stockouts and contributing to the company's financial performance. PLAYING YOUR PART Planning and processes optimisation through data modelling and in-depth analysis of Demand, Inventory, Logistics and Supplier performance to support decision-making Analyse Supply Chain performance and monitor operational KPIs Optimise Inventory through Stock Management best practices Lead process analysis and enhancement improvement initiatives Support systems enhancements and implementation projects (ERP, reporting tools, automation) Collaborate cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Logistics, Production, and Retail teams Be a support and sharing agent for the Supply Planning and Purchasing Planning functions WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require: Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Business Analytics 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Manufacturing and a global understanding of the end-to-end dynamics Proficiency in advanced analytics tools and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Anaplan, Power BI, GCP & Looker a plus) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights Excellent communication skills in English and French Positive attitude and growth mindset with a strong sense of ownership and keen eye for detail. Questa posizione richiede una stretta collaborazione con team interfunzionali, tra cui Finance, Development, Commercial and Production Planning per sviluppare, analizzare, migliorare ed eseguire piani di approvvigionamento efficaci. L'Ingegnere della Supply Chain svolge un ruolo fondamentale con iniziative strategiche in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), nuove presentazioni di prodotti, garantendo la disponibilità dei prodotti senza soluzione di continuità, riducendo al minimo le scorte e contribuendo alle prestazioni finanziarie dell'azienda. La tua parte Pianificazione e processi di ottimizzazione attraverso la modellazione dei dati e l'analisi approfondita delle prestazioni di domanda, inventario, logistica e fornitore per supportare le prestazioni decisionali Analyse Supply Chain e monitorare le KPI operative Optimise Inventory attraverso le migliori pratiche di gestione delle azioni Analisi del processo di piombo e miglioramento iniziative di miglioramento Supporti miglioramenti dei sistemi e progetti di implementazione (ERP, strumenti di reporting, automazione) Collaborare con team di pianificazione, appalti, logistica, produzione e vendita al dettaglio Essere un agente di supporto e condivisione per la pianificazione di approvvigionamento e l'acquisto di funzioni di pianificazione che cosa vi farà SUCCESSFUL? Il successo di questo ruolo richiederà: laurea magistrale in Supply Chain, Engineering o Business Analytics 5+ anni di esperienza nel settore della produzione di catene di approvvigionamento e una comprensione globale della dinamica end-to-end Proficiency negli strumenti avanzati di analisi e sistemi ERP (ad esempio, SAP, Anaplan, Power BI, GCP & Looker a plus) Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving con la capacità di tradurre i dati in intuizioni attuabili Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e francese atteggiamento positivo e mentalità di crescita con un forte senso di proprietà e occhio attento per i dettagli. Vacheron Constantin celebra 270 anni come orologiaio più antico del mondo in produzione continua dal 1755. Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, gestiamo una rete globale di vendita al dettaglio di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità globale di orologiai, artigiani e professionisti dedicati condividono una comune devozione al nostro patrimonio eccezionale e alla passione per la sciabola di un futuro ancora più luminoso. jobs.title: Procurement Excellence Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129217 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Richemont Procurement department is responsible for sourcing and purchasing the goods and services that enable our group's operations. We're committed to driving efficiency, sustainability, and innovation in every purchase we make. Our key initiatives include: Strengthening indirect procurement across the group through our P2P Project, ensuring seamless and efficient processes. Embracing data-driven decision-making to optimize every purchase and unlock new opportunities. Digitalizing end-to-end procurement with our eSHOP platform. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129269 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. "Integrity and excellence are the foundations of trust in business and the pillars for a sustainable success. You are passionate and eager to make an impact, apply now!” WHAT DO WE OFFER At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive. We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences. 
• We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity. We celebrate every achievement, big or small, fostering meaningful connections through gratitude and mutual support, nurturing a sense of belonging. Join us at Cartier, a place like no other, forever moving forward. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT Are you passionate about Compliance, Risk Management and Process Improvement? Are you interested in exploring the diverse projects within the Cartier International Risk & Compliance Department? As an International Compliance Risk Manager, you will be responsible for the Maison Compliance Risk Framework, aiming to strengthen adherence to applicable Legal and Regulatory requirements through a structured and comprehensive approach. You will be reporting to Cartier International Head of Risk and Compliance and will be based in Meyrin (Switzerland). Cartier International Risk & Compliance Department reports to the Maison CFO and mainly covers the following scope of responsibilities: Regulatory compliance, related to the adherence to external Laws and Regulations relevant to the activities of the Maison. Business compliance, encompasses Cartier internal rules, procedures, control framework and business processes. Risk management, involves identifying the Maison's strategic risks through an Enterprise Risk Management approach and defining appropriate mitigation plans. In a context of increasing volume, complexity and pace of regulatory change across Regions and Functions, and the deployment of Maison sustainability initiatives, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Compliance Risk Manager. This role will involve two key missions: Defining and leading the Maison’s Compliance Risk framework, contributing to the Group-wide Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Monitoring strategic initiative; Supporting the Cartier Sustainability team as the Maison Finance Sustainability Lead. Compliance Risk Management (80%) Creating a comprehensive Compliance Risk Management Governance structure for the Maison, engaging key stakeholders from all Functions and Regions. Coordinating this Risk Network by establishing a communication, consultation and engagement strategy. Delivering training to Compliance Risk Stakeholders to ensure a successful IRM tool adoption. Conducting the assessment of the Maison's Compliance and Regulatory risks, in collaboration with subject matter experts. These risk categories arise from legal and regulatory obligations and encompasses diverse domains such as Finance (e.g., money laundering), Legal (e.g., antitrust, conflicts of interest), Security, Procurement (e.g., responsible sourcing), IT, Sustainability, and Product Trade Compliance. Identifying existing controls, procedures and measures, and developing new action plans with the support of Maison Risk & Compliance Team, to address and mitigate identified risks. Establishing a continuous monitoring process to oversee the implementation of Compliance Risk Management strategies. Actively communicating and coordinating with Group Compliance to ensure alignment of vision and strategy. Maintaining Group IRM tool with relevant identified risks, actions, and outcomes obtained. Developing Key Risk Indicators (KRI) and establishing reporting on a regular basis. Communicating to Stakeholders in a clear and effective manner. Sustainability Projects (20%) As the Finance Sustainability Lead representing Cartier International Finance Department, you will provide operational support to the Cartier Sustainability team in all initiatives requiring Finance or Compliance expertise: Supporting the non-financial reporting process by assisting the Cartier Sustainability team with financial data collection and analysis on specific expense categories. Responding to regular Responsible Jewellery Council (RJC) certification and monitoring audits on all provisions related to Finance, Compliance and Regulatory matters (Cartier is certified against the RJC Code of Practices – COP- since 2010). Integrating RJC standards into Cartier compliance process and control design to ensure alignment between COP evolutions and Cartier Compliance framework. Contributing to the annual ISO 20121 certification for all Compliance-related matters, working in collaboration with other Maison functions (such as HR, Security, Marketing, and Commercial, etc.). Providing Financial Expertise for sustainability initiatives: partner with the Cartier Sustainability team on all finance-related initiatives. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR You have a minimum of 10 years of professional experience in Compliance and Risk Management functions, or in Consulting activities, with a Master’s Degree in Business School, in Finance or in Law. You have a solid understanding of Regulatory and Compliance requirements, and Internal Control frameworks. You possess a strong history of effectively implementing and managing Risk Management frameworks. You have proven strong capacity to foster collaboration, teamwork, and cross-functional alignment. You demonstrate ability to articulate clear positions, defend them with conviction, and explain their rationale. You are able to organize a daily workload by priorities and demonstrate proven organizational & project management skills. You’re driven with the daily passion to cultivate high ethical standards and integrity to actively role model the Cartier’s compliance standards. You have ERP system knowledge (SAP, Power BI, Looker). You are able to manage stress and confidentiality with a high-level of discretion. You are at ease multitasking and rapidly adapt to changing priorities and schedules. You are fluent in multiple languages including mandatory spoken and written English. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will give you an introductory call to explain further steps and discuss the opportunity. If things go well on both ends, you will have a chance to meet the Hiring Manager and the HR Manager. Take your next step with Cartier, we look forward to hearing from you! descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR129269 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. "L'integrità e l'eccellenza sono le fondamenta della fiducia nel business e i pilastri per un successo sostenibile. Sei appassionato e desideroso di fare un impatto, applica ora!” A Cartier, farai parte di una comunità legata da un forte senso di responsabilità, dove la connessione, la collaborazione e lo spirito collettivo prosperano. Potenziamo i singoli talenti, uniti da un impegno condiviso per l'eccellenza, ispirato alle diverse culture del mondo, per rispettare e arricchire il nostro patrimonio unico. Crediamo che diverse prospettive alimentano l'innovazione e ci spingono a creare esperienze eccezionali.
• Offriamo un ambiente energizzante per la crescita della carriera e l'opportunità di contribuire la vostra visione individuale a un'eredità di creatività. Celebriamo ogni risultato, grande o piccolo, promuovendo connessioni significative attraverso la gratitudine e il sostegno reciproco, alimentando un senso di appartenenza. Unisciti a noi a Cartier, un posto come nessun altro, per sempre andare avanti. Come si fa ad avere un iMPATTO Sei appassionato di Compliance, Risk Management e Process Improvement? Sei interessato a esplorare i diversi progetti all'interno del reparto Rischio Internazionale Cartier? In qualità di Responsabile del Rischio di Compliance International, sarai responsabile del quadro di rischio di conformità della Maison, mirando a rafforzare l'adesione ai requisiti legali e regolamentari applicabili attraverso un approccio strutturato e completo. Si sarà riferito a Cartier International Head of Risk and Compliance e sarà basato in Meyrin (Svizzera). Cartier International Risk & Compliance Department riferisce alla Maison CFO e copre principalmente la seguente portata di responsabilità: conformità normativa, relativa all'adesione a leggi e regolamenti esterni rilevanti per le attività della Maison. Conformità aziendale, comprende regole interne Cartier, procedure, quadro di controllo e processi aziendali. La gestione dei rischi comporta l'individuazione dei rischi strategici della Maison attraverso un approccio Enterprise Risk Management e la definizione di piani di mitigazione appropriati. In un contesto di aumento del volume, della complessità e del ritmo dei cambiamenti normativi tra Regioni e Funzioni e dell'implementazione delle iniziative di sostenibilità della Maison, stiamo cercando un responsabile del rischio di conformità dinamico ed esperto. Questo ruolo coinvolgerà due missioni chiave: Definire e guidare il quadro di Compliance Risk della Maison, contribuendo all’iniziativa strategica di regolazione, monitoraggio del rischio e della conformità a livello di Gruppo; sostenere il team di Cartier Sustainability come leader di sostenibilità della Maison Finance. Gestione del rischio di conformità (80%) Creazione di una struttura completa di gestione del rischio di conformità per la Maison, coinvolgendo le parti interessate chiave da tutte le funzioni e regioni. Coordinare questa rete di rischio attraverso la creazione di una strategia di comunicazione, consultazione e impegno. Fornire formazione agli Stakeholder di Rischio di Compliance per garantire un'adozione di strumenti IRM di successo. Condurre la valutazione dei rischi di conformità e regolamentazione della Maison, in collaborazione con esperti di materia tematica. Queste categorie di rischio derivano da obblighi legali e regolamentari e comprendono diversi domini come la finanza (ad esempio, riciclaggio di denaro), Legale (ad esempio, antitrust, conflitti di interesse), Sicurezza, Procurement (ad esempio, sourcing responsabile), IT, Sostenibilità e Product Trade Compliance. Identificare i controlli, le procedure e le misure esistenti e sviluppare nuovi piani d'azione con il supporto di Maison Risk & Compliance Team, per affrontare e mitigare i rischi identificati. Stabilire un processo di monitoraggio continuo per supervisionare l'attuazione delle strategie di gestione dei rischi di conformità. Comunicare e coordinare attivamente con Compliance di Gruppo per garantire l'allineamento della visione e della strategia. Mantenere lo strumento Gruppo IRM con rischi, azioni e risultati identificati rilevanti ottenuti. Sviluppare indicatori chiave di rischio (KRI) e stabilire rapporti su base regolare. Comunicare agli Stakeholders in modo chiaro ed efficace. Progetti di Sostenibilità (20%) Come capo della Sostenibilità Finance che rappresenta il Dipartimento di Finanza Internazionale di Cartier, fornirete il supporto operativo al team di Sostenibilità di Cartier in tutte le iniziative che richiedono competenze di Finanza o Compliance: Sostenere il processo di reporting non finanziario aiutando il team di Sostenibilità Cartier con raccolta e analisi dei dati finanziari su specifiche categorie di spesa. Rispondendo a regolari Responsible Jewellery Council (RJC) certificazioni e controlli di audit su tutte le disposizioni relative a finanza, conformità e questioni regolamentari (Cartier è certificato contro il Codice di Pratiche RJC – COP- dal 2010). Integrare gli standard RJC nel processo di conformità Cartier e la progettazione di controllo per garantire l'allineamento tra le evoluzioni COP e il framework di conformità Cartier. Contribuire alla certificazione ISO 20121 annuale per tutte le questioni relative alla conformità, lavorando in collaborazione con altre funzioni della Maison (come HR, Sicurezza, Marketing e Commerciale, ecc.). Fornire competenze finanziarie per iniziative di sostenibilità: partner del team Cartier Sustainability per tutte le iniziative legate alla finanza. Che cosa stiamo cercando Hai un minimo di 10 anni di esperienza professionale nelle funzioni di Compliance e Risk Management, o nelle attività di Consulenza, con un Master in Business School, in Finanza o in Diritto. Hai una solida comprensione dei requisiti normativi e di conformità e dei quadri di controllo interno. Possiedi una forte storia di implementare e gestire efficacemente i quadri di Risk Management. Hai dimostrato una forte capacità di promuovere la collaborazione, il lavoro di squadra e l'allineamento interfunzionale. Lei dimostra la capacità di articolare posizioni chiare, difenderle con convinzione, e spiegare la loro razionalità. Reference code: JR129269 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. "Integrity and excellence are the foundations of trust in business and the pillars for a sustainable success. You are passionate and eager to make an impact, apply now!” WHAT DO WE OFFER At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive. We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences. 
• We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity. We celebrate every achievement, big or small, fostering meaningful connections through gratitude and mutual support, nurturing a sense of belonging. Join us at Cartier, a place like no other, forever moving forward. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT Are you passionate about Compliance, Risk Management and Process Improvement? Are you interested in exploring the diverse projects within the Cartier International Risk & Compliance Department? As an International Compliance Risk Manager, you will be responsible for the Maison Compliance Risk Framework, aiming to strengthen adherence to applicable Legal and Regulatory requirements through a structured and comprehensive approach. You will be reporting to Cartier International Head of Risk and Compliance and will be based in Meyrin (Switzerland). Cartier International Risk & Compliance Department reports to the Maison CFO and mainly covers the following scope of responsibilities: Regulatory compliance, related to the adherence to external Laws and Regulations relevant to the activities of the Maison. Business compliance, encompasses Cartier internal rules, procedures, control framework and business processes. Risk management, involves identifying the Maison's strategic risks through an Enterprise Risk Management approach and defining appropriate mitigation plans. In a context of increasing volume, complexity and pace of regulatory change across Regions and Functions, and the deployment of Maison sustainability initiatives, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Compliance Risk Manager. This role will involve two key missions: Defining and leading the Maison’s Compliance Risk framework, contributing to the Group-wide Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Monitoring strategic initiative; Supporting the Cartier Sustainability team as the Maison Finance Sustainability Lead. Compliance Risk Management (80%) Creating a comprehensive Compliance Risk Management Governance structure for the Maison, engaging key stakeholders from all Functions and Regions. Coordinating this Risk Network by establishing a communication, consultation and engagement strategy. Delivering training to Compliance Risk Stakeholders to ensure a successful IRM tool adoption. Conducting the assessment of the Maison's Compliance and Regulatory risks, in collaboration with subject matter experts. These risk categories arise from legal and regulatory obligations and encompasses diverse domains such as Finance (e.g., money laundering), Legal (e.g., antitrust, conflicts of interest), Security, Procurement (e.g., responsible sourcing), IT, Sustainability, and Product Trade Compliance. Identifying existing controls, procedures and measures, and developing new action plans with the support of Maison Risk & Compliance Team, to address and mitigate identified risks. Establishing a continuous monitoring process to oversee the implementation of Compliance Risk Management strategies. Actively communicating and coordinating with Group Compliance to ensure alignment of vision and strategy. Maintaining Group IRM tool with relevant identified risks, actions, and outcomes obtained. Developing Key Risk Indicators (KRI) and establishing reporting on a regular basis. Communicating to Stakeholders in a clear and effective manner. Sustainability Projects (20%) As the Finance Sustainability Lead representing Cartier International Finance Department, you will provide operational support to the Cartier Sustainability team in all initiatives requiring Finance or Compliance expertise: Supporting the non-financial reporting process by assisting the Cartier Sustainability team with financial data collection and analysis on specific expense categories. Responding to regular Responsible Jewellery Council (RJC) certification and monitoring audits on all provisions related to Finance, Compliance and Regulatory matters (Cartier is certified against the RJC Code of Practices – COP- since 2010). Integrating RJC standards into Cartier compliance process and control design to ensure alignment between COP evolutions and Cartier Compliance framework. Contributing to the annual ISO 20121 certification for all Compliance-related matters, working in collaboration with other Maison functions (such as HR, Security, Marketing, and Commercial, etc.). Providing Financial Expertise for sustainability initiatives: partner with the Cartier Sustainability team on all finance-related initiatives. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR You have a minimum of 10 years of professional experience in Compliance and Risk Management functions, or in Consulting activities, with a Master’s Degree in Business School, in Finance or in Law. You have a solid understanding of Regulatory and Compliance requirements, and Internal Control frameworks. You possess a strong history of effectively implementing and managing Risk Management frameworks. You have proven strong capacity to foster collaboration, teamwork, and cross-functional alignment. You demonstrate ability to articulate clear positions, defend them with conviction, and explain their rationale. You are able to organize a daily workload by priorities and demonstrate proven organizational & project management skills. You’re driven with the daily passion to cultivate high ethical standards and integrity to actively role model the Cartier’s compliance standards. You have ERP system knowledge (SAP, Power BI, Looker). You are able to manage stress and confidentiality with a high-level of discretion. You are at ease multitasking and rapidly adapt to changing priorities and schedules. You are fluent in multiple languages including mandatory spoken and written English. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will give you an introductory call to explain further steps and discuss the opportunity. If things go well on both ends, you will have a chance to meet the Hiring Manager and the HR Manager. Take your next step with Cartier, we look forward to hearing from you! Code de référence: JR129269 L'histoire de Cartier est fondée sur la curiosité et la passion. Nos plus de 10 000 collègues de plus de 105 nationalités sont unis par un esprit indépendant partagé et un engagement en faveur de l'excellence, s'efforçant d'enrichir continuellement notre patrimoine de Maison en repoussant les frontières de la créativité et de l'innovation. « L'intégrité et l'excellence sont les fondements de la confiance dans les entreprises et les piliers d'un succès durable. Vous êtes passionné et désireux de faire un impact, appliquez maintenant ! QU'ON OFFRE Chez Cartier, vous ferez partie d'une communauté liée par un fort sens des responsabilités, où la connexion, la collaboration et l'esprit collectif prospèrent. Nous autonomisons les talents individuels, unis par un engagement commun en faveur de l'excellence, inspiré par les diverses cultures du monde, pour respecter et enrichir notre patrimoine unique. • Nous offrons un environnement stimulant pour la croissance de carrière et la possibilité de contribuer à votre vision individuelle à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réalisations, grandes ou petites, favorisant des relations significatives par la gratitude et le soutien mutuel, nourrissant un sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous à Cartier, un endroit comme personne d'autre, toujours aller de l'avant. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact Êtes-vous passionné par la conformité, la gestion des risques et l'amélioration des processus? Êtes-vous intéressé à explorer les divers projets au sein du département Risques et Conformité international Cartier? En tant que gestionnaire international des risques liés à la conformité, vous serez responsable du Cadre de risques liés à la conformité de Maison, qui vise à renforcer le respect des exigences légales et réglementaires applicables par une approche structurée et globale. Vous ferez rapport à Cartier International Head of Risk and Compliance et serez basé à Meyrin (Suisse). Cartier International Risk & Compliance Department rend compte à la Maison CFO et couvre principalement la portée des responsabilités suivantes : Conformité réglementaire, liée au respect des lois et règlements externes pertinents aux activités de la Maison. La conformité aux règles, procédures, cadre de contrôle et processus opérationnels internes de Cartier. La gestion des risques consiste à identifier les risques stratégiques de la Maison au moyen d'une approche de gestion des risques d'entreprise et à définir des plans d'atténuation appropriés. Dans un contexte d'accroissement du volume, de la complexité et du rythme des changements réglementaires dans les régions et les fonctions, ainsi que du déploiement des initiatives de durabilité de Maison, nous recherchons un gestionnaire du risque de conformité dynamique et expérimenté. Ce rôle comprendra deux missions clés : Définir et diriger le cadre de gestion des risques liés à la conformité de la Maison, contribuant à l'initiative stratégique de surveillance de la réglementation, des risques et de la conformité à l'échelle du Groupe; Soutenir l'équipe de développement durable de Cartier en tant que responsable de développement durable de la Maison Finance. Gestion des risques liés à la conformité (80 %) Création d'une structure complète de gestion des risques liés à la conformité pour la Maison, avec la participation des principaux intervenants de toutes les fonctions et régions. Coordonner ce réseau des risques en établissant une stratégie de communication, de consultation et d'engagement. Offrir de la formation aux intervenants qui s'intéressent aux risques liés à la conformité afin d'assurer une adoption réussie de l'outil de GIR. Effectuer l'évaluation des risques liés à la conformité et à la réglementation de la Maison, en collaboration avec des experts en la matière. Ces catégories de risque découlent d'obligations juridiques et réglementaires et englobent divers domaines tels que les finances (p. ex., le blanchiment d'argent), les questions juridiques (p. ex., la lutte contre les ententes, les conflits d'intérêts), la sécurité, l'approvisionnement (p. ex., l'approvisionnement responsable), la TI, la durabilité et la conformité au commerce des produits. Identifier les contrôles, les procédures et les mesures existants et élaborer de nouveaux plans d'action avec l'appui de l'équipe de la Maison Risk & Compliance, afin de traiter et d'atténuer les risques identifiés. Établir un processus de surveillance continue pour superviser la mise en oeuvre des stratégies de gestion des risques liés à la conformité. Communication active et coordination avec le Groupe Conformité pour assurer l'alignement de la vision et de la stratégie. Maintenir l'outil de GIR du groupe avec les risques, les mesures et les résultats pertinents identifiés. Élaborer des indicateurs de risque clés et établir des rapports réguliers. Communiquer avec les intervenants de manière claire et efficace. Projets de développement durable (20%) En tant que responsable des finances et de la durabilité représentant le ministère des Finances de Cartier International, vous fournirez un soutien opérationnel à l'équipe de développement durable de Cartier dans toutes les initiatives nécessitant une expertise en finances ou en conformité. Réponse à des audits réguliers de certification et de surveillance de toutes les dispositions relatives aux finances, à la conformité et à la réglementation du Conseil des bijoux responsables (Cartier est certifié en conformité avec le Code de pratiques du CCR – COP- depuis 2010). Intégrer les normes RJC dans le processus de conformité Cartier et la conception de contrôle pour assurer l'alignement entre les évolutions de la COP et le cadre de conformité Cartier. Contribution à la certification annuelle ISO 20121 pour toutes les questions liées à la conformité, en collaboration avec d'autres fonctions de Maison (comme les RH, la sécurité, le marketing et le commerce, etc.). Fournir une expertise financière pour les initiatives de développement durable : partenariat avec l'équipe de développement durable Cartier sur toutes les initiatives liées au financement. Pour quoi sommes-nous prêts? Vous disposez d'un minimum de 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les fonctions de conformité et de gestion des risques, ou dans les activités de conseil, avec un Master en Business School, en Finance ou en Droit. Vous avez une bonne compréhension des exigences en matière de réglementation et de conformité et des cadres de contrôle interne. Vous avez une solide histoire de mettre en oeuvre et de gérer efficacement les cadres de gestion des risques. Vous avez démontré une forte capacité de favoriser la collaboration, le travail d'équipe et l'alignement interfonctionnel. Vous démontrez votre capacité à formuler des positions claires, à les défendre avec conviction et à expliquer leur raison d'être. Vous pouvez organiser une charge de travail quotidienne selon les priorités et démontrer des compétences éprouvées en gestion d'organisation et de projet. Vous êtes conduit avec la passion quotidienne de cultiver des normes éthiques élevées et l'intégrité pour jouer un rôle actif modèle les normes de conformité Cartier. Vous avez une connaissance du système ERP (SAP, Power BI, Looker). Vous pouvez gérer le stress et la confidentialité avec un haut niveau de discrétion. Vous êtes à l'aise multitâche et vous adapter rapidement à l'évolution des priorités et des horaires. Vous parlez couramment plusieurs langues, y compris l'anglais parlé et écrit obligatoire. VOTRE JOURNÉE AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, nous vous donnerons un appel d'introduction pour expliquer les étapes suivantes et discuter de l'opportunité. Si les choses se passent bien aux deux bouts, vous aurez la chance de rencontrer le gestionnaire de l'embauche et le gestionnaire des RH. Faites votre prochaine étape avec Cartier, nous avons hâte de vous entendre! Attaccato al Direttore Organizzazione e Pianificazione Strategica, si opera come una vera e propria società di consulenza interna a La Maison, intervenendo su questioni di taglio trasversale e strutturazione relative allo sviluppo organizzativo di La Maison. Lei è mandato dai membri del Comitato Esecutivo. Nell'ambito delle vostre missioni, voi: team di supporto nella formalizzazione di una visione strategica previsionale, nonché l'identificazione di questioni operative e organizzative. Progetti di piombo: definendo obiettivi, inquadramento e approccio progettuale. Partecipa al processo di bilancio in collaborazione con le risorse umane. Fornire supporto metodologico per portare la cultura del progetto internamente. Più di un lavoro... Stiamo reclutando per una carriera! Integrare Van Cleef & Arpels è soprattutto un team in cui lo sviluppo dei dipendenti è al centro della nostra ambizione. Dalla vostra integrazione, sarete immersi nel mondo della Casa grazie alle formazioni sulla nostra storia, il know-how e la cultura. Applicare direttamente online. Se il tuo profilo viene selezionato, sei contattato dal team HR per un'intervista. Conosci l'Organizzazione del Progetto Direttore. In caso contrario, riceverai un'email informandoti del rifiuto della tua richiesta. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129243 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. VOTRE MISSION : Vous réaliserez des gravures d'une extrême finesse et précision afin d'embellir et de personnaliser les pièces en respectant les standards de qualité et de tradition de la Maison. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? Sur la production : Réaliser des opérations de gravure sur les composants horlogers et joaillers (pièces de mécanisme, ébauches ou boîtes) Utiliser des techniques de gravure au trait, modelé, incrustation sur toute matière Pouvoir travailler sur pièces émaillées S’assurer de la conformité et de la qualité des pièces livrées Maîtrise des outils spécifiques (binoculaires, échoppes…) Respecter le processus de fabrication Sur les nouveautés : Travailler sur des petites séries ou pièces uniques Participer à l’industrialisation des nouveaux produits Savoir se projeter en 3D Capacité à interpréter, adapter une photo pour un rendu à graver Sur l’atelier : Travailler en équipe avec les autres métiers artisans de l’atelier Être force de proposition d’amélioration continue COMMENT RÉUSSIREZ-VOUS CHEZ NOUS ? Vous avez une expérience dans le domaine de la gravure indispensable, idéalement dans un milieu horloger, avec de préférence entre 3-5 ans de pratique. Vous êtes passionné et vous faites preuve d’exigence, de minutie et de précision dans votre travail. Vous aimez travailler en équipe et avez de bonnes capacités de communication. Vous êtes ouvert à la participation d’évènements pour la présentation du métier (bilingue serait un plus) Similar Jobs Emailleur Qualifié Save Le Sentier, Switzerland Jaeger-LeCoultre Sertisseur (H/F) Save Le Sentier, Switzerland Jaeger-LeCoultre Stagiaire Ingénieur - Amélioration Continue SAV Save Le Sentier, Switzerland Jaeger-LeCoultre

jobs.title: Store Design & Planning Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129288 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Join Piaget HQ's dynamic Store Design & Planning team and play a pivotal role in shaping exceptional luxury retail environments globally. You'll support a dedicated team of Project Managers, contributing to store project development, design execution, and market coordination. This unique internship offers the chance to work on cross-functional projects, develop store designs through drawings and 3D models, and immerse yourself in the intricate world of high-end jewelry and watchmaking retail design, collaborating with international teams and various departments. Internship duration: 12 months, starting September 1st, 2026. To be considered for this role, please submit a cover letter and a resume. Key 
• Responsibilities: Technical drawings and layouts (AutoCAD) 3D modelling (3ds Max, Rhino, SketchUp, or equivalent software) Research and development of new concepts (3D visualizations and photo retouching) Preparation of presentation materials (PowerPoint, InDesign, Illustrator) Point-of-sale design development (AutoCAD, 3ds Max, Acrobat Pro) Project budgeting and tender management (Excel) HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are currently pursuing or hold a master’s degree in architecture or interior design You are passionate about Luxury Retail and sensitive to aesthetics, spatial design, and graphic expression within projects You are organized, versatile, rigorous, and open-minded You have strong proficiency in the following software: AutoCAD, SketchUp, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Acrobat You are highly skilled in rendering tools such as V-Ray, 3ds Max, and Rhino You have a good command of the Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel, as well as SharePoint You are fluent in English (French would be considered a plus) STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! jobs.description: Reference code: JR129325 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de l’atelier de Prototypes, vous réalisez les prototypes et les éléments de test des composants habillage et procédez aux ajustements nécessaires, en amont de la fabrication. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Vous collaborez étroitement avec le bureau d'études pour évaluer les plans et la faisabilité des dossiers techniques Vous définissez l’outillage nécessaire et préparez les postes Vous gérez la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commande numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles Vous prenez en charge le contrôle dimensionnel des pièces Vous collaborez avec d’autres départements internes et vous contribuez à l’amélioration continue du département QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Au bénéfice d’un CFC de micro-mécanicien avec une orientation faiseur d’étampes, ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie dans la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commandes numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles. Des compétences en décolletage sont un atout. Vous maîtrisez le logiciel CREO et êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. Vous avez également des connaissances dans la lecture de plans et dans la manipulation des instruments de mesure et de contrôle (calibre, micromètre, comparateur, projecteur, etc.). Des connaissances en bijouterie-joaillerie sont un plus, ainsi que la maîtrise du soudage au chalumeau et laser. Vous êtes une personne motivée, dynamique, polyvalente, ayant un bon esprit d’équipe et appréciez travailler dans un environnement de travail agile. QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? Nous créons un environnement positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et renforcées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour atteindre l'excellence. VOTRE PARCOURS CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique au plus vite avec notre équipe RH. Par la suite, vous accèderez à un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable Prototypes ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Tout au long de son histoire, la Maison Cartier s'est distinguée par l'engagement de chacun de ses employés. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont pleinement assumées, l'innovation et la créativité émergent pour offrir l'excellence. Quelles que soient les différences visibles ou invisibles, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où chacun a une chance égale de réaliser son plein potentiel, d'être entendu et de se sentir valorisé. Des compétences en décolletage sont un atout. Vous maîtrisez le logiciel CREO et êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. Vous avez également des connaissances dans la lecture de plans et dans la manipulation des instruments de mesure et de contrôle (calibre, micromètre, comparateur, projecteur, etc.). Des connaissances en bijouterie-joaillerie sont un plus, ainsi que la maîtrise du soudage au chalumeau et laser. Vous êtes une personne motivée, dynamique, polyvalente, ayant un bon esprit d’équipe et appréciez travailler dans un environnement de travail agile. QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? Nous créons un environnement positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et renforcées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour atteindre l'excellence. VOTRE PARCOURS CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique au plus vite avec notre équipe RH. Par la suite, vous accèderez à un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable Prototypes ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Tout au long de son histoire, la Maison Cartier s'est distinguée par l'engagement de chacun de ses employés. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont pleinement assumées, l'innovation et la créativité émergent pour offrir l'excellence. Quelles que soient les différences visibles ou invisibles, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où chacun a une chance égale de réaliser son plein potentiel, d'être entendu et de se sentir valorisé. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129324 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Sur la production : Réaliser des opérations d’émaillage sur les composants horlogers et joaillers (de la préparation de la surface au lapidage de la pièce) Utiliser des techniques d’émaillage grand feu, champlevé, grisaille S’assurer de la conformité et de la qualité des pièces livrées Maîtrise des outils spécifiques (binoculaires, fours…) Respecter le processus de fabrication Sur les nouveautés : Travailler sur des petites séries Participer à l’industrialisation des nouveaux produits Capacité d’analyse d’un processus Capacité à interpréter un visuel du design Sur l’atelier : Travailler en équipe avec les autres métiers artisans de l’atelier Être force de proposition d’amélioration continue LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Expérience dans le domaine de l’émaillage indispensable, dans un milieu de Haute Horlogerie, avec de préférence entre 3-5 ans de pratique, Une connaissance en matériaux serait un plus. Vous êtes passionné et vous faites preuve d’exigence, de minutie et de précision dans votre travail. Vous aimez travailler en équipe et avez de bonnes capacités de communication. Garantir le respect des quantités, des délais et de la qualité Créer et suivre les procédés de fabrication de l’atelier. Entretenir les installations et les bains de galvanoplastie. Définir et faire réaliser les outillages nécessaires au traitement des pièces. Participer à la mise à jour, au suivi et à l’amélioration des standards de l’atelier Galvanoplastie. Assurer l’intégration et la mise au point des nouveaux process de l’atelier Galvanoplastie Participer aux industrialisations des nouveaux produits et assurer le suivi des premières séries. Assurer un soutien au leader Galvanoplaste et aux passeurs aux bains. Assurer une suppléance en production si nécessaire. En qualité de garant environnemental, hygiène et sécurité Être acteur et responsable de la sécurité Auditer le respect des règles de l’entreprise COMMENT RÉUSSIREZ-VOUS CHEZ NOUS ? Education : Diplômé d’un Master en Chimie et Galvanoplastie ou formation équivalente. jobs.title: Procurement Category Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129333 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for a Procurement Category Manager dedicated to Corporate Services categories. Reporting to the Category Director Corporate & Operations, you will be responsible for developing and driving comprehensive global category strategies as well as supporting our Central Functions, Maisons and Regions Procurement community to optimize sourcing and supplier management for your categories. This role is instrumental in ensuring optimal value creation and cost efficiency, through category expertise, market knowledge, strong internal and external relationship management. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Procurement Category Manager, your main responsibilities will include: Global Category Strategy Development & Leadership: Develop, define, and implement comprehensive global category strategies aligned with Richemont’s (Group/Maisons/Regions) business needs & Objectives. Lead the execution and roll-out of category strategies across various Maisons and regions through business partnering, stakeholders enrolling and influencing. Drive value creation, cost reduction, and innovation across the assigned categories through deep market knowledge, category expertise, and a forward-thinking approach. Sourcing, Market Intelligence & Supplier Relationship Management Manage complex tenders, negotiations, and contract management for global and central agreements, ensuring favorable terms and conditions. Conduct market analysis and competitive intelligence for the assigned category. Develop and maintain comprehensive knowledge of the global supplier landscape, identifying strategic partners and emerging suppliers. Develop and implement strategic SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) programs for key suppliers, fostering long-term partnerships. Lead regular strategic business reviews with critical suppliers to drive continuous improvement and innovation. Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key internal stakeholders across functions, Maisons and Regions to understand business needs and ensure category strategies support overall business goals. Act as a trusted advisor to internal clients on procurement best practices, market insights, and supplier capabilities. Support central functions sourcing needs for central spend & global initiatives. Performance Management & Compliance: Monitor category performance, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and report on progress against strategic objectives and financial targets. Ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and sourcing process rules, ethical guidelines, and external regulations. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are an established and versatile procurement professional with 7+ years of experience in a structured environment, with strong category management skills. Experience and knowledge within the Corporate services area, ideally Security and Facilities Management categories, is an advantage. You have: Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated ability to develop and implement global category strategies, driving significant value creation, cost optimization, and innovation. RFPs, Negotiation & Contract Management: Excellent RFP, negotiation and contract management abilities, with a proven track record of securing advantageous terms. Stakeholder Management: Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, capable of engaging effectively with diverse internal and external partners at all levels, including senior leadership. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and creative solutions. Adaptability: Demonstrated learning agility and adaptability to evolving market conditions and business needs. Autonomy & Drive: Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, getting the buy-in from stakeholders and leading execution. Proactive, results-oriented, and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international, and demanding environment. Sustainability Focus: A strong commitment to responsible sourcing and integrating sustainability principles into procurement practices. Academics: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, Marketing and Professional certifications. Languages: Fluent in both English and French. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Strategic Sourcing Manager, Store Construction Save New York, United States of America Richemont Regional Marketing & Merchandising, Category Manager Save Singapore, Singapore Cartier Director, Strategic Sourcing Save New York, United States of America Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129333 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Richemont sta cercando un Procurement Categoria Manager dedicato alle categorie Corporate Services. Segnalando al Direttore categoria Corporate & Operations, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e della guida di strategie di categoria globali e del supporto alla nostra community di Functions, Maisons e Regional Procurement per ottimizzare la gestione dei fornitori e degli approvvigionamenti per le tue categorie. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per garantire la creazione di valore ottimale e l'efficienza dei costi, attraverso competenze di categoria, conoscenze di mercato, una forte gestione dei rapporti interni ed esterni. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In qualità di responsabile della categoria di appalti, le vostre principali responsabilità includono: Global Categoria Strategy Development & Leadership: Sviluppare, definire e implementare strategie di categoria globali complete allineate alle esigenze aziendali e agli obiettivi di Richemont. Guidare l'esecuzione e l'implementazione di strategie di categoria in diverse Maison e regioni attraverso partner commerciali, stakeholder che si iscrivono e influenzano. Creare valore di guida, ridurre i costi e l'innovazione in tutte le categorie assegnate attraverso la conoscenza del mercato profondo, la competenza di categoria e un approccio avanzato. Sourcing, Market Intelligence & Supplier Relationship Management Gestisci le offerte complesse, i negoziati e la gestione dei contratti per gli accordi globali e centrali, garantendo termini e condizioni favorevoli. Condurre l'analisi del mercato e l'intelligenza competitiva per la categoria assegnata. Sviluppare e mantenere una conoscenza completa del panorama dei fornitori globali, identificare partner strategici e fornitori emergenti. Sviluppare e implementare programmi strategici SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) per fornitori chiave, promuovendo partnership a lungo termine. Guidare regolari recensioni strategiche di business con fornitori critici per guidare il miglioramento continuo e l'innovazione. Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con i principali stakeholder interni tra funzioni, Maisons e Regioni per comprendere le esigenze aziendali e garantire strategie di categoria sostenere gli obiettivi aziendali globali. Agire come consulente di fiducia per i clienti interni sulle migliori pratiche di approvvigionamento, le intuizioni di mercato e le capacità dei fornitori. Sostenere le funzioni centrali che sourcing esigenze di spesa centrale e iniziative globali. Performance Management & Compliance: Monitorare le prestazioni della categoria, monitorare gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI), e segnalare i progressi contro gli obiettivi strategici e gli obiettivi finanziari. Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche di approvvigionamento interno e le regole di processo di approvvigionamento, le linee guida etiche e le normative esterne. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Sei un professionista di approvvigionamento consolidato e versatile con 7+ anni di esperienza in un ambiente strutturato, con forti competenze di gestione della categoria. L'esperienza e la conoscenza nell'area dei servizi aziendali, idealmente le categorie di gestione della sicurezza e delle strutture, è un vantaggio. Hai: Acumen strategico: Capacità dimostrata di sviluppare e implementare strategie di categoria globali, guidando la creazione di valore significativo, l'ottimizzazione dei costi e l'innovazione. RFP, negoziazione e gestione dei contratti: eccellente RFP, negoziazioni e capacità di gestione dei contratti, con una comprovata traccia di garantire termini vantaggiosi. Stakeholder Management: Forte comunicazione, influenza e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, in grado di coinvolgere efficacemente con diversi partner interni ed esterni a tutti i livelli, tra cui leadership senior. Competenze analitiche e problem-solving: Forte capacità analitiche e problem-solving, con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight attuabili e soluzioni creative. Adaptability: Agilità di apprendimento dimostrata e adattabilità alle condizioni di mercato in evoluzione e alle esigenze aziendali. Autonomia & Drive: Demonstrated mindset imprenditoriale, con un approccio proattivo per identificare le opportunità, ottenere il buy-in da stakeholder e l'esecuzione leader. Proattivi, orientati ai risultati e in grado di lavorare autonomamente in un ambiente veloce, internazionale e esigente. Focus sulla sostenibilità: un forte impegno a sostenere e integrare i principi di sostenibilità nelle pratiche di approvvigionamento. Accademica: laurea o master in appalti, Supply Chain, Business, Marketing e Certificazioni professionali. Lingue: fluente sia in inglese che in francese. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Strategic Sourcing Manager, Store Construction Save New York, United States of America Richemont Regional Marketing & Merchandising, Categoria Manager Save Singapore, Singapore Cartier Director, Strategic Sourcing Save New York, United States of America Richemont
